title.zh: 卷五 本紀第五 文帝
title.raw: 卷五 本紀第五 文帝 Volume 5 Annals 5: Emperor Wen

sentences.zh: 景平二年七月中，少帝廢。

translations.literal: In the middle of the seventh month of the second year of Jingping, the Young Emperor was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Jingping, the Young Emperor was deposed.

sentences.zh: 百官備法駕奉迎，入奉皇統。

translations.literal: All officials prepared the imperial standards and carriage to welcome him, entering to receive the imperial succession.
translations.idiomatic: The officials prepared the imperial escort to welcome him and install him in the imperial line.

sentences.zh: 行臺至江陵，進璽紱。

translations.literal: When the itinerant headquarters reached Jiangling, they presented the seal and ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: When the mobile imperial secretariat reached Jiangling, the seal and ribbon of investiture were presented.

sentences.zh: 侍中臣琇、散騎常侍臣嶷之、中書監尚書令護軍將軍建城縣公臣亮、左衞將軍臣景仁、給事中游擊將軍龍鄉縣侯臣隆、越騎校尉都亭侯臣綱、給事黃門侍郎臣孔璩之、散騎侍郎臣劉思考、員外散騎侍郎臣潘盛、中書侍郎臣何尚之、羽林監封陽縣開國侯臣蕭思話、長兼尚書左丞德陽縣侯臣孫康、吏部郎中騎都尉臣張茂度、儀曹郎中臣徐長琳、倉部郎中臣庾俊之、都官郎中臣袁洵等上表曰：「臣聞否泰相革，數窮則變，天道所以不謟，卜世所以靈長。

translations.literal: Attendant-in-Ordinary Pei, Regular Attendant Cao, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Director of the Masters of Writing, General Who Protects the Army and Duke of Jiancheng Liang, Left Guards General Jingren, Attendant-of-the-Interior and General Who Punishes Brigands and Marquis of Longxiang Long, Colonel of Rapid Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Gang, Attendant and Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Kong Suizhi, Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Supernumerary Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Pan Sheng, Gentleman Attendant of the Masters of Writing He Shangzhi, Colonel of the Feathered Forest and Marquis Who Opens the State of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Senior Concurrent Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section, and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel and Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Gentleman of the Ministry of Rites Xu Changlin, Gentleman of the Ministry of Granaries Yu Junzhi, Gentleman of the Ministry of Punishments Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial, saying: "We have heard that adversity and prosperity transform each other; when the number is exhausted, change follows—this is why the Way of Heaven does not conceal itself, and why prognostications of a dynasty's duration prove enduring."
translations.idiomatic: Attendant-in-Ordinary Pei, Regular Attendant Cao, Supervisor and Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army Duke of Jiancheng Liang, Left Guards General Jingren, Attendant-of-the-Interior and General Who Punishes Brigands Marquis of Longxiang Long, Colonel of Rapid Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Gang, Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Kong Suizhi, Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Supernumerary Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Pan Sheng, Gentleman Attendant of the Masters of Writing He Shangzhi, Colonel of the Feathered Forest and Opening Marquis of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Senior Concurrent Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section, and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel and Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Gentleman of the Ministry of Rites Xu Changlin, Gentleman of the Ministry of Granaries Yu Junzhi, Gentleman of the Ministry of Punishments Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial: "We have heard that fortune and misfortune alternate; when the cycle reaches its limit, change ensues. That is why Heaven's way does not hide itself, and why auguries of a dynasty's span endure."

sentences.zh: 乃者運距陵夷，王室艱晦，九服之命，靡所適歸，高祖之業，將墜于地。

translations.literal: Recently the mandate has declined, the royal house has been in distress, and commands from the nine domains have had nowhere to go; the enterprise of the High Ancestor was about to fall to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Of late the mandate has waned, the royal house has fallen on hard times, and the allegiance of the realm has had nowhere to turn; the founding enterprise was on the verge of collapse.

sentences.zh: 賴基厚德深，人神同奬，社稷以寧，有生獲乂。

translations.literal: Relying on your deep and thick foundation of virtue, men and spirits alike lent their aid, so that the altars of state were secured and the living were brought to order.
translations.idiomatic: Thanks to your profound virtue, heaven and earth lent their support, the altars of state were secured, and the people were restored to peace.

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下君德自然，聖明在御，孝悌著於家邦，風猷宣於蕃牧。

translations.literal: We humbly consider that Your Majesty's sovereign virtue is innate, sagely clarity holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty shine in the family and state, and your civilizing influence is proclaimed in the border provinces.
translations.idiomatic: We humbly observe that Your Majesty's royal virtue is innate, sagely wisdom guides the throne, filial piety and fraternity are manifest at home and abroad, and your civilizing influence extends through the frontier commanderies.

sentences.zh: 是以徵祥雜沓，符瑞㸌煇。

translations.literal: Therefore auspicious signs have come in profusion, and talismanic omens blaze with brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Hence auspicious portents have crowded in, and prophetic signs have blazed forth.

sentences.zh: 宗廟神靈，乃眷西顧，萬邦黎獻，望景託生。

translations.literal: The spirits of the ancestral temple have turned their gaze westward; the myriad states and the common people look to your radiance and entrust their lives to you.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits of the ancestral temple have turned westward in favor; all the realms and peoples look to your radiance and place their hopes in you.

sentences.zh: 臣等忝荷朝列，豫充將命，復集休明之運，再覩太平之業。

translations.literal: We, who undeservedly bear office in the court, have had the honor of carrying your commission, and again gather in this flourishing and enlightened age, once more beholding the enterprise of great peace.
translations.idiomatic: We who unworthily serve in court ranks have been privileged to bear your commission, and now find ourselves again in a flourishing age, witnessing once more the advent of great peace.

sentences.zh: 行臺至止，瞻望城闕，不勝喜說鳧藻之情，謹詣門拜表以聞。

translations.literal: When the itinerant headquarters arrived and halted, gazing upon the city towers, we could not contain our joy like ducks on the waterweed; we respectfully come to the gate to submit this memorial for your information.
translations.idiomatic: When the mobile secretariat arrived and we beheld the capital towers, we could scarcely contain our joy; we respectfully present this memorial at the gate to inform Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 」上答曰：「皇運艱弊，數鍾屯夷，仰惟崇基，感尋國故，永慕厥躬，悲慨交集。

translations.literal: The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been hard pressed, and the number has struck repeated adversity; looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel and recall the state's past, forever longing for that person, and grief and emotion mingle together.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been beset with hardship, and the times have brought repeated adversity. Looking up to the lofty foundation, I recall the nation's past and forever mourn that person; grief and emotion overwhelm me.

sentences.zh: 賴七百祚永，股肱忠賢，故能休否以泰，天人式序。

translations.literal: Relying on the enduring fortune of the seven hundred years, and on loyal and worthy arms and legs of state, we have therefore been able to turn adversity into prosperity and bring heaven and man into proper order.
translations.idiomatic: Thanks to the enduring mandate of seven hundred years and to loyal, worthy ministers, adversity has been turned to prosperity and heaven and humanity brought into harmony.

sentences.zh: 猥以不德，謬降大命，顧己兢悸，何以克堪。

translations.literal: I am unworthy in my baseness, yet the great mandate has mistakenly descended upon me; looking back at myself I tremble with fear—how could I bear it?
translations.idiomatic: Unworthy as I am, the great mandate has mistakenly fallen to me; I tremble at myself—how could I be equal to it?

sentences.zh: 輒當暫歸朝庭，展哀陵寢，并與賢彥申寫所懷。

translations.literal: I shall for the present return to the court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy men set forth what is in my heart.
translations.idiomatic: I shall presently return to court, pay mourning respects at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy ministers express what is in my heart.

sentences.zh: 望體其心，勿為辭費。

translations.literal: I hope you will enter into my feelings and not be excessive in your words.
translations.idiomatic: I ask you to understand my heart and not be excessive in your expressions.

sentences.zh: 」府州佐史並稱臣，請題牓諸門，一依宮省，上不許。

translations.literal: The aides and clerks of the prefecture and province all styled themselves subjects and requested that placards be inscribed on every gate, all according to the palace standards; the Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The aides and clerks of the prefecture and province all styled themselves subjects and asked that placards be posted on every gate in palace fashion; the Emperor did not consent.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，發江陵。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, he set out from Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, he departed from Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，車駕至京城。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.

sentences.zh: [1]丁酉，謁初寧陵，還於中堂即皇帝位。

translations.literal: [1] On the dingyou day, he visited the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: [1] On the dingyou day, he visited the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 元嘉元年秋八月丁酉，大赦天下，改景平二年為元嘉元年。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day of the eighth month in autumn of the first year of Yuanjia, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and the second year of Jingping was changed to the first year of Yuanjia.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the eighth month in autumn of the first year of Yuanjia, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and the second year of Jingping was renamed the first year of Yuanjia.

sentences.zh: 文武賜位二等，逋租宿債勿復收。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted two ranks of promotion; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were promoted two ranks; overdue rents and old debts were remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以行撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦為撫軍將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Xie Hui, Acting General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Xie Hui, Acting General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was confirmed as General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，司空、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之進位司徒，衞將軍、江州刺史王弘進位司空，中書監、護軍將軍傅亮加左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦進號衞將軍，鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟進號征北將軍。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister of Works, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was promoted to Minister over the Masses; Wang Hong, General of the Guard and Governor of Jiang Province, was promoted to Minister of Works; Fu Liang, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was given the additional title of Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and Palace Minister of Equal Rank with the Three Dukes; Xie Hui, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced in title to General of the Guard; Tan Daoji, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns against the North.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister of Works, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was promoted to Minister over the Masses; Wang Hong, General of the Guard and Governor of Jiang Province, became Minister of Works; Fu Liang, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was additionally appointed Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Xie Hui, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to General of the Guard; Tan Daoji, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was advanced to General Who Campaigns against the North.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，追尊所生胡婕妤為皇太后，諡曰章后。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, his biological mother, Lady Hu, Gentleman of Graceful Beauty, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager, with the posthumous title Empress Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, his birth mother, Lady Hu, Gentleman of Graceful Beauty, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager with the temple name Empress Zhang.

sentences.zh: 衞將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康進號驃騎將軍，冠軍將軍、南豫州刺史義恭進號撫軍將軍，封江夏王。

translations.literal: The Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was advanced in title to General of Agile Cavalry; Yigong, General Who Conquers and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the Army and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was advanced to General of Agile Cavalry; Yigong, General Who Conquers and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 立第六皇弟義宣為竟陵王，第七皇弟義季為衡陽王。

translations.literal: The sixth younger imperial brother, Yixuan, was established as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger imperial brother, Yiji, as Prince of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth imperial younger brother Yixuan was created Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger brother Yiji was created Prince of Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以豫州刺史劉粹為雍州刺史，驍騎將軍管義之為豫州刺史，南蠻校尉到彥之為中領軍。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Liu Cui, Governor of Yu Province, was made Governor of Yong Province; Guan Yizhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, was made Governor of Yu Province; and Dao Yanzhi, Colonel of Southern Man, was made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Liu Cui, Governor of Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yong Province; Guan Yizhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, became Governor of Yu Province; and Dao Yanzhi, Colonel of Southern Man, was appointed General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 己酉，減荊、湘二州今年稅布之半。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, this year's cloth tax of Jing and Xiang provinces was reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the cloth tax for Jing and Xiang provinces for the current year was reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，立妃袁氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the ninth month, Consort Yuan was established as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the ninth month, Lady Yuan was installed as Empress.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙寅，司徒徐羨之、尚書令傅亮奉表歸政，上始親覽。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day of the first month in spring of the second year, Xu Xianzhi, Minister over the Masses, and Fu Liang, Director of the Masters of Writing, submitted memorials returning power to the throne, and the Emperor began to attend to affairs in person.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the first month in spring of the second year, Minister over the Masses Xu Xianzhi and Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang submitted memorials restoring government to the throne, and the Emperor began to rule in person.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕祠南郊，[2]大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, the imperial carriage performed sacrifice at the southern suburb; [2] a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the Emperor sacrificed at the southern suburb; [2] a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，左將軍、徐州刺史王仲德進號安北將軍。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the third month, Wang Zhongde, General of the Left and Governor of Xu Province, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the third month, Wang Zhongde, General of the Left and Governor of Xu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊寅，特進謝澹卒。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day in the fifth month of summer, Xie Dan, Special Grandee, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day in the fifth month of summer, Special Grandee Xie Dan died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲申，以關中流民出漢川，置京兆、扶風、馮翊等郡。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day in the eighth month of autumn, because refugees from the Guanzhong region had fled out through the Han River valley, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, Fengyi, and others were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day in the eighth month of autumn, because Guanzhong refugees had fled into the Han River region, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, Fengyi, and others were established.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康為開府儀同三司，新除司空王弘為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，以右軍長史江恒為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, the Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was given the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Wang Hong, newly appointed Minister of Works, was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Jiang Heng, Senior Clerk of the Right Army, was made Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, received the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong became Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry with the same privilege; and Jiang Heng, Senior Clerk of the Right Army, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸酉，以前將軍楊玄為征西將軍、北秦州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day in the eleventh month of winter, Yang Xuan, former General of the Front, was made General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day in the eleventh month of winter, former General of the Front Yang Xuan was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之，尚書令、護軍將軍、左光祿大夫傅亮，有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day of the first month in spring of the third year, Xu Xianzhi, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, and Fu Liang, Director of the Masters of Writing, General Who Protects the Army, and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, were guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the first month in spring of the third year, Xu Xianzhi, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, and Fu Liang, Director of the Masters of Writing, General Who Protects the Army, and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, were found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 遣中領軍到彥之、征北將軍檀道濟討荊州刺史謝晦，上親率六師西征。

translations.literal: The Central Army General Dao Yanzhi and the General Who Campaigns against the North Tan Daoji were sent to attack Xie Hui, Governor of Jing Province; the Emperor personally led the Six Armies on a western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and General Who Campaigns against the North Tan Daoji were dispatched against Xie Hui, Governor of Jing Province; the Emperor personally led the Six Armies westward.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以車騎大將軍、江州刺史王弘為司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改為荊州刺史，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史江夏王義恭改為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, Wang Hong, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jiang Province, was made Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province; the Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was transferred to Governor of Jing Province; the Prince of Jiangxia, Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was transferred to Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Wang Hong, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jiang Province, became Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Jing Province; Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以前護軍將軍趙倫之為鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, Zhao Lunzhi, former General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, former General Who Protects the Army Zhao Lunzhi was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌，皇子劭生。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，繫囚見徒，一皆原赦。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the second month, all prisoners in custody and convicts under sentence were entirely pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the second month, all prisoners in custody and convicts under sentence were fully pardoned.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以金紫光祿大夫王敬弘為尚書左僕射，豫章太守鄭鮮之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, Wang Jinghong, Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section; Zheng Xianzhi, Administrator of Yuzhang, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Wang Jinghong, Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section; Zheng Xianzhi, Administrator of Yuzhang, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section.

sentences.zh: 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian'an, was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian'an, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: [3]庚申，特進范泰加光祿大夫。

translations.literal: [3] On the gengshen day, Fan Tai, Special Grandee, was given the additional title of Grandee of Splendid Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: [3] On the gengshen day, Special Grandee Fan Tai was additionally appointed Grandee of Splendid Virtue.

sentences.zh: 是日，車駕發京師。

translations.literal: On that day, the imperial carriage set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, the imperial carriage departed the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，到彥之、檀道濟大破謝晦於隱磯。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji routed Xie Hui decisively at Yinji.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕自蕪湖反斾。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the imperial carriage turned back from Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，擒晦於延頭，送京師伏誅。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, Hui was captured at Yantou, sent to the capital, and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Hui was captured at Yantou, sent to the capital, and executed.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙未，以征北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟為征南大將軍、江州刺史，中領軍到彥之為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day in the fifth month of summer, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns against the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made General Who Campaigns South and Governor of Jiang Province; Dao Yanzhi, General of the Central Army, was made Governor of Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day in the fifth month of summer, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns against the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns South and Governor of Jiang Province; Dao Yanzhi, General of the Central Army, became Governor of Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以後將軍長沙王義欣為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, the Prince of Changsha, Yixin, General of the Rear, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Prince of Changsha Yixin, General of the Rear, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，驃騎大將軍、涼州牧大沮渠蒙遜改為車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, Juqu Mengxun, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Liang Province, was changed to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Juqu Mengxun, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Liang Province, was redesignated Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「夫哲王宰世，廣達四聰，猶巡嶽省方，採風觀政。

translations.literal: An edict said: "When a sage king governs the age, he broadly extends his four senses, yet still tours the mountains and inspects the regions, gathering folk songs to observe government.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "When a sage king rules the world, he extends his awareness in every direction, yet still tours the sacred mountains and inspects the regions, gathering folk songs to observe how government is conducted.

sentences.zh: 所以情偽必審，幽遐罔滯，王澤無擁，九皐有聞者也。

translations.literal: By this means truth and falsehood are surely examined, the remote and hidden are not blocked, the king's favor is not obstructed, and the nine marshes have those who will listen.
translations.idiomatic: Thus truth and falsehood are thoroughly examined, the distant and obscure are not neglected, royal grace is not blocked, and news reaches the court from every quarter.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡薄，猥纂洪緒。

translations.literal: I, in my paltriness and shallowness, have basely succeeded to the great succession.
translations.idiomatic: I, paltry and shallow as I am, have unworthily inherited the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 雖永念治道，志存昧旦，願言傅巖，發想宵寐，而丘園之秀，藏器未臻，物情民隱，尚隔視聽。

translations.literal: Although I forever bear governance in mind and aspire to rise before dawn, longing for Fu Yue's cliff and rousing my thoughts even in sleep, yet the excellence of hill and garden remains hidden and its vessels unrevealed, and the feelings of things and the grievances of the people are still cut off from sight and hearing.
translations.idiomatic: Though I constantly ponder the way of governance and aspire to rise before dawn, longing for a Fu Yue in my service and thinking of it even in sleep, worthy men in retirement remain unrevealed, and the people's circumstances and hidden grievances still do not reach my ears.

sentences.zh: 乃眷區域，輟寢忘飡。

translations.literal: Therefore I turn my thoughts to the realm, laying aside sleep and forgetting to eat.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore my thoughts turn to the realm; I set aside sleep and forget my meals.

sentences.zh: 今氛祲袪蕩，宇內寧晏，旌賢弘化，於是乎始。

translations.literal: Now the baleful vapors have been swept away and the realm within the four seas is tranquil; to raise the worthy and expand transformation begins from this moment.
translations.idiomatic: Now the evil mists have been cleared and the realm is at peace; the promotion of worthies and the spread of civilizing influence begin here.

sentences.zh: 可遣大使巡行四方。

translations.literal: Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Grand envoys shall be dispatched to tour the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 其宰守稱職之良，閨蓽一介之善，詳悉列奏，勿或有遺。

translations.literal: As for prefects and magistrates who are competent, and goodness even in a single man of humble gate, report them all in detail and let none be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: As for prefects and magistrates who perform their duties well, and any good act by even the humblest subject, report all in full and omit nothing.

sentences.zh: 若刑獄不卹，政治乖謬，傷民害教者，具以事聞。

translations.literal: If punishments and prisons are not compassionate, or government and policy are perverse, harming the people and injuring instruction, report the facts in full.
translations.idiomatic: If judicial punishments lack mercy, or governance is perverse and harms the people and undermines instruction, report the particulars in full.

sentences.zh: 其高年、鰥寡、幼孤、六疾不能自存者，可與郡縣優量賑給。

translations.literal: As for the aged, widowers and widows, orphans and the young, and those with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves, the commanderies and counties may generously assess relief and provide for them.
translations.idiomatic: As for the elderly, widows and widowers, orphans and the young, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves, the commanderies and counties shall generously assess relief and provide for them.

sentences.zh: 博採輿誦，廣納嘉謀，務盡銜命之旨，俾若朕親覽焉。

translations.literal: Broadly gather popular songs, widely receive excellent plans, and strive to fulfill the intent of your commission, as though I were viewing matters in person.
translations.idiomatic: Gather popular songs broadly, receive excellent counsel widely, and fulfill the intent of your commission as though I were reviewing matters myself.

sentences.zh: 」丙午，車駕臨延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, the imperial carriage attended at the Hall for Extending Worth to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the Emperor presided at the Hall for Extending Worth to hear lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，以鎮軍將軍趙倫之為左光祿大夫、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the sixth month, Zhao Lunzhi, General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and General of the Forward Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the sixth month, Zhao Lunzhi, General Who Pacifies the Army, was appointed Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and General of the Forward Army.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車駕又於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, the imperial carriage again heard lawsuits at the Hall for Extending Worth.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the Emperor again heard lawsuits at the Hall for Extending Worth.

sentences.zh: 丙子，又聽訟。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, he again heard lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, he again heard lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 以右衞王華為中護軍。

translations.literal: Wang Hua of the Right Guards was made General of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hua of the Right Guards was appointed General of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊寅，以梁、南秦二州刺史吉翰為益州刺史，驃騎參軍劉道產為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day in the eleventh month of winter, Ji Han, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was made Governor of Yi Province; Liu Daochan, Staff Officer of Agile Cavalry, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day in the eleventh month of winter, Ji Han, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was appointed Governor of Yi Province; Liu Daochan, Staff Officer of Agile Cavalry, became Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以南蠻校尉劉遵考為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, Liu Zunkao, Colonel of Southern Man, was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Liu Zunkao, Colonel of Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，以中書侍郎蕭思話為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guichou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Sihua, Gentleman Attendant of the Masters of Writing, was made Governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Sihua, Gentleman Attendant of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，前吳郡太守徐佩之謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, Xu Peizhi, former Administrator of Wu Commandery, plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, former Administrator of Wu Commandery Xu Peizhi plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙亥朔，曲赦都邑百里內。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the first of the first month in spring of the fourth year, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within a hundred li of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the new year's day of the first month in spring of the fourth year, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within a hundred li of the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，行幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，詔曰：「丹徒桑梓綢繆，大業攸始，踐境永懷，觸感罔極。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is bound to me by native place and intimate ties; the great enterprise began there. Treading that ground, I forever cherish it, and my stirred feelings know no limit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is bound to me by native soil and deep ties; the great enterprise began there. Setting foot on that ground awakens everlasting feeling, and my stirred emotions know no bound.

sentences.zh: 昔漢章南巡，加恩元氏，況情義二三，有兼曩日。

translations.literal: Formerly, when Emperor Zhang of Han toured the south, he added favor to the Yuan clan; how much more, when affection and righteousness are two or threefold, does this exceed former days.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhang of Han toured the south, he extended favor to the Yuan clan; how much more should I, when affection and obligation are redoubled, exceed what was done in former days.

sentences.zh: 思播遺澤，酬慰士民。

translations.literal: I think to spread lingering grace and repay and comfort the gentry and people.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to spread lingering grace and repay and comfort the gentry and people.

sentences.zh: 其蠲此縣今年租布，五歲刑以下皆悉原遣；

translations.literal: Let this county's grain and cloth tax for this year be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are entirely pardoned and released;
translations.idiomatic: Let this county's grain and cloth tax for the current year be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are to be fully pardoned and released;

sentences.zh: 登城三戰及大將家，隨宜隱卹。

translations.literal: families of those who fought in the three assaults on the city wall and families of great generals shall receive condolence and relief as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: families of those who fought in the three assaults on the walls and families of great generals shall receive condolence and relief as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，尚書右僕射鄭鮮之卒。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Zheng Xianzhi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Zheng Xianzhi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section, died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禁斷夏至日五絲命縷之屬，富陽令諸葛闡之之議也。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, the use of five-colored life-cords and the like on the summer solstice was forbidden—this was the proposal of Zhuge Chanzhi, Magistrate of Fuyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the use on the summer solstice of five-colored life cords and similar items was forbidden—this followed the proposal of Zhuge Chanzhi, Magistrate of Fuyang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，以廷尉王徽之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day in the fourth month of summer, Wang Huizhi, Commandant of Punishments, was made Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day in the fourth month of summer, Wang Huizhi, Commandant of Punishments, was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，中護軍王華卒。

translations.literal: On the renwu day in the fifth month, Wang Hua, General of the Guard, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day in the fifth month, Wang Hua, General of the Guard, died.

sentences.zh: 京師疾疫，甲午，遣使存問，給醫藥；

translations.literal: An epidemic struck the capital; on the jiawu day, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine;
translations.idiomatic: An epidemic struck the capital; on the jiawu day, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine;

sentences.zh: 死者若無家屬，賜以棺器。

translations.literal: if the dead had no family, coffins and burial goods were bestowed upon them.
translations.idiomatic: where the dead had no family, coffins and burial goods were provided.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, the first of the sixth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the first of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以金紫光祿大夫殷穆為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Yin Mu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Yin Mu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙亥，詔曰：「朕恭承洪業，臨饗四海，風化未弘，治道多昧，求之人事，鑒寐惟憂。

translations.literal: On the yihai day of the first month in spring of the fifth year, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and preside over feasting on the four seas; civilization is not yet broadly spread, and the way of governance has many obscurities; seeking it in human affairs, I reflect whether awake or asleep with only worry.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the first month in spring of the fifth year, an edict said: "I respectfully inherit the great enterprise and rule over the four seas; civilization is not yet broadly spread, and the way of governance remains obscure in many respects; when I seek guidance in human affairs, I reflect whether waking or sleeping with nothing but anxiety.

sentences.zh: 加頃陰陽違序，旱疫成患，仰惟災戒，責深在予。

translations.literal: Moreover, of late yin and yang have been out of order, drought and pestilence have become calamities; looking up to the warning of disaster, the blame lies deep with me.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, of late yin and yang have fallen out of harmony, and drought and pestilence have become calamities; looking up to these warnings of disaster, the blame lies chiefly with me.

sentences.zh: 思所以側身剋念，議獄詳刑，上答天譴，下恤民瘼。

translations.literal: I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on prisons and examine punishments, answer heaven's reproof above, and comfort the people's afflictions below.
translations.idiomatic: I consider how to examine myself and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on prisons and examine punishments, answer heaven's reproof above, and relieve the people's afflictions below.

sentences.zh: 羣后百司，其各獻讜言，指陳得失，勿有所諱。

translations.literal: The host of ministers and the hundred offices: each shall present loyal words, point out gains and losses, and let nothing be concealed.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and officials of every rank: each shall present loyal counsel, point out what is right and wrong, and conceal nothing.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，車駕臨玄武館閱武。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, the imperial carriage attended at the Black Tortoise Pavilion to review the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the Emperor attended at the Black Tortoise Pavilion to review the troops.

sentences.zh: 戊子，京邑大火，遣使巡慰賑賜。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour and comfort the people and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour the districts, comfort the people, and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，以南蠻校尉蕭摹之為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jihai day in the fourth month of summer, Xiao Muzhi, Colonel of Southern Man, was made Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day in the fourth month of summer, Xiao Muzhi, Colonel of Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以始興太守徐豁為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, Xu Huo, Administrator of Shixing, was made Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Xu Huo, Administrator of Shixing, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，以湘州刺史張邵為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jimao day of the fifth month, Zhang Shao, Governor of Xiang Province, was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the fifth month, Zhang Shao, Governor of Xiang Province, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，司徒王弘降為衞將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the sixth month, Wang Hong, Minister over the Masses, was reduced to General of the Guard with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the sixth month, Minister over the Masses Wang Hong was demoted to General of the Guard with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 京邑大水，乙卯，[4]遣使檢行賑贍。

translations.literal: The capital region suffered great flooding; on the yimao day, [4] envoys were sent to inspect the districts and provide relief and sustenance.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods struck the capital; on the yimao day, [4] envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief.

sentences.zh: 以江夏內史程道惠為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Cheng Daohui, Administrator of Jiangxia, was made Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Daohui, Administrator of Jiangxia, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬戌，特進、左光祿大夫范泰卒。

translations.literal: On the renxu day in the eighth month of autumn, Fan Tai, Special Grandee and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day in the eighth month of autumn, Special Grandee and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue Fan Tai died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day in the tenth month of winter, the imperial carriage heard cases at the Hall of Extended Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day in the tenth month of winter, the Emperor heard legal cases at the Hall of Extended Worthies.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸未，以右軍司馬劉德武為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day of the intercalary month, Liu Dewu, Senior Clerk of the Right Army, was made Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the intercalary month, Liu Dewu, Senior Clerk of the Right Army, was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，安陸公相周籍之為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, Zhou Jizhi, chief administrator of the Duchy of Anlu, was made Governor of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Zhou Jizhi, chief administrator of the Duchy of Anlu, was appointed Governor of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，左光祿大夫、領軍將軍趙倫之卒。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day of the twelfth month, Zhao Lunzhi, Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and General Who Leads the Army, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the twelfth month, Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and General Who Leads the Army Zhao Lunzhi died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天竺國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year, the state of Tianzhu sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Tianzhu sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛丑，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on the xinchou day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the first month in spring of the sixth year, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以驃騎將軍、荊州刺史彭城王義康為司徒、錄尚書事，領平北將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province, was made Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and concurrently General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, while retaining the posts of General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province.

translations.literal: Editorial note five in the received text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note five marks a commentary insertion in the received text at this point.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，立皇子劭為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the third month, the imperial son Shao was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the third month, the imperial son Shao was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大赦天下，賜文武位一等。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以左衞將軍殷景仁為中領軍。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, Yin Jingren, General of the Left Guards, was made Director of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Yin Jingren, General of the Left Guards, was appointed Director of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，以尚書左僕射王敬弘為尚書令，丹陽尹臨川王義慶為尚書左僕射，吏部尚書江夷為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the guihai day in the fourth month of summer, Wang Jinghong, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section, was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Governor of Danyang, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section; and Jiang Yi, Minister of Personnel, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day in the fourth month of summer, Wang Jinghong, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section, became Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Governor of Danyang, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section; and Jiang Yi, Minister of Personnel, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the renchen month in the fifth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, renchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以新除尚書令王敬弘為特進、左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On the gisi day, Wang Jinghong, newly appointed Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Special Grandee and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On the gisi day, newly appointed Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jinghong was made Special Grandee and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以撫軍司馬劉道濟為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Liu Daoji, Senior Clerk of the Pacification Army, was made Governor of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Liu Daoji, Senior Clerk of the Pacification Army, was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，於雍州置馮翊郡。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, the commandery of Fengyi was established in Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the commandery of Fengyi was established within Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，以尚書左丞孔默之為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the seventh month, Kong Mozhi, Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the seventh month, Kong Mozhi, Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，百濟王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That month, the king of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the king of Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，於秦州置隴西、宋康二郡。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the ninth month, the commanderies of Longxi and Songkang were established in Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the ninth month, the commanderies of Longxi and Songkang were established in Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，中領軍殷景仁丁艱去職。

translations.literal: On the renshen day in the tenth month of winter, Yin Jingren, Director of the Central Army, left office on account of mourning for a parent.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day in the tenth month of winter, Director of the Central Army Yin Jingren left office to observe mourning for a parent.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the jichou month in the eleventh month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, jichou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day of the twelfth month, the state of Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the twelfth month, Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

translations.literal: Editorial note six in the received text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note six marks a commentary insertion in the received text at this point.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月癸巳，以吐谷渾慕容璝為征西將軍、沙州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on the gisi day, Murong Gui of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gisi day of the first month in spring of the seventh year, Murong Gui of the Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭國王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That month, the king of Wa sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the king of Wa sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，遣右將軍到彥之北伐，水軍入河。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the third month, Dao Yanzhi, General of the Right, was dispatched on a northern campaign; the navy entered the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the third month, Dao Yanzhi, General of the Right, was sent north on campaign, and the fleet entered the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Yin Chong, former Senior Clerk of the General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was made Inspector of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Yin Chong, former Senior Clerk of the General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was appointed Inspector of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: [7]甲寅，以前中領軍殷景仁為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: [7] On the jiayin day, Yin Jingren, former Director of the Central Army, was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: [7] On the jiayin day, former Director of the Central Army Yin Jingren was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day in the fourth month of summer, the state of Karahoton sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day in the fourth month of summer, Karahoton sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，以冠軍將軍氐楊難當為秦州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jimao day of the sixth month, Yang Nandang of the Di, General of Valiant Cavalry, was made Governor of Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the sixth month, the Di chieftain Yang Nandang, General of Valiant Cavalry, was appointed Governor of Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，索虜碻磝戍棄城走。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day in the seventh month of autumn, the Suolu garrison at Qiuyao abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day in the seventh month of autumn, the Suolu garrison at Qiuyao abandoned the city and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以平北諮議參軍甄法護為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, Zhen Fahu, Consulting Colonel of the Army Who Pacifies the North, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Zhen Fahu, Consulting Colonel of the Army Who Pacifies the North, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，索虜滑臺戍棄城走。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, the Suolu garrison at Huatai abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the Suolu garrison at Huatai abandoned the city and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，林邑國、訶羅陁國、師子國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, the states of Linyi, Karahoton, and Shizi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Linyi, Karahoton, and Shizi sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，罷南豫州并豫州。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day in the tenth month of winter, Southern Yu Province was abolished and merged into Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day in the tenth month of winter, Southern Yu Province was abolished and incorporated into Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 以左將軍竟陵王義宣為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Prince of Jingling Yixuan, General of the Left, was made Governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jingling Yixuan, General of the Left, was appointed Governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 戊午，立錢署，鑄四銖錢。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, a mint office was established and four-zhu coins were cast.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, a mint was established and four-zhu coins were cast.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，金墉城為索虜所陷。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Jinyong city was captured by the Suolu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Jinyong fell to the Suolu.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，虎牢城復為索虜所陷。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day of the eleventh month, Hulao was again captured by the Suolu.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the eleventh month, Hulao again fell to the Suolu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣征南大將軍檀道濟北討，右將軍到彥之自滑臺奔退。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns South, was dispatched on a northern punitive campaign; Dao Yanzhi, General of the Right, fled in retreat from Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, General Who Campaigns South Tan Daoji was sent north on a punitive campaign, while General of the Right Dao Yanzhi fled in retreat from Huatai.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，以南兗州刺史長沙王義欣為豫州刺史，司徒司馬吉翰為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the twelfth month, Prince of Changsha Yixin, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Governor of Yu Province, and Ji Han, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was made Inspector of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the twelfth month, Prince of Changsha Yixin, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Governor of Yu Province, and Ji Han, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was appointed Inspector of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，京邑火，延燒太社北牆。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, fire broke out in the capital and spread to burn the north wall of the Altar of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, fire broke out in the capital and spread to the north wall of the Altar of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 兗州刺史竺靈秀有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Zhu Lingxiu, Inspector of Yan Province, was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Lingxiu, Inspector of Yan Province, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月庚寅，於交州復立珠崖郡。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day of the first month in spring of the eighth year, the commandery of Zhuya was re-established in Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the first month in spring of the eighth year, the commandery of Zhuya was re-established in Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以左軍將軍申宣為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gisi day, Shen Xuan, General of the Left Army, was made Inspector of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gisi day, Shen Xuan, General of the Left Army, was appointed Inspector of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns South, defeated the Suolu at Shouzhang in Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, General Who Campaigns South Tan Daoji defeated the Suolu at Shouzhang in Dongping.

translations.literal: Editorial note eight in the received text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note eight marks a commentary insertion in the received text at this point.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，以平北司馬韋朗為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the second month, Wei Lang, Senior Clerk of the Army Who Pacifies the North, was made Inspector of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the second month, Wei Lang, Senior Clerk of the Army Who Pacifies the North, was appointed Inspector of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以尚書右僕射江夷為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, Jiang Yi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section, was made Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Jiang Yi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，滑臺為索虜所陷。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, Huatai was captured by the Suolu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Huatai fell to the Suolu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，征南大將軍檀道濟引軍還。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns South, led his army back.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, General Who Campaigns South Tan Daoji withdrew his army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，青州刺史蕭思話棄城走。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, Xiao Sihua, Inspector of Qing Province, abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Xiao Sihua, Inspector of Qing Province, abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 以太子右衞率劉遵考為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Zunkao, Leader of the Right Guards of the Heir Apparent, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zunkao, Leader of the Right Guards of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day of the third month, the imperial carriage heard cases at the Hall of Extended Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the third month, the Emperor heard legal cases at the Hall of Extended Worthies.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「自頃軍役殷興，國用增廣，資儲不給，百度尚繁。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Of late military service has flourished and state expenses have grown; stores are insufficient and the hundred administrations remain burdensome.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Of late military campaigns have multiplied and state expenditures have swollen; reserves no longer suffice and government remains overburdened.

sentences.zh: 宜存簡約，以應事實。

translations.literal: It is fitting to preserve simplicity and frugality to match actual circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: Simplicity and restraint should be maintained to match what the times require.

sentences.zh: 內外可通共詳思，務令節儉。」

translations.literal: Inside and outside the court may jointly deliberate in detail, striving to ensure economy."
translations.idiomatic: Within and beyond the court all should deliberate together and strive for thrift."

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，以衡陽王師阮萬齡為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day in the fourth month of summer, Ruan Wanling, Tutor to the Prince of Hengyang, was made Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day in the fourth month of summer, Ruan Wanling, Tutor to the Prince of Hengyang, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以後軍參軍徐遵之為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Xu Zunzhi, Senior Clerk of the Rear Army, was made Inspector of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Xu Zunzhi, Senior Clerk of the Rear Army, was appointed Inspector of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the sixth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the sixth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，割江南及揚州晉陵郡屬南徐州，江北屬兗州。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, the Jiangnan region and Jinling commandery of Yang Province were attached to Southern Xu Province, and the region north of the river was attached to Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the Jiangnan region and Jinling commandery in Yang Province were placed under Southern Xu Province, and the territory north of the river was placed under Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 以徐州刺史竟陵王義宣為南兗州刺史，司徒司馬吉翰為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Inspector of Xu Province, was changed to Governor of Southern Yan Province; Ji Han, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was made Inspector of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Inspector of Xu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Southern Yan Province; Ji Han, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was appointed Inspector of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚子，詔曰：「自頃農桑惰業，遊食者眾，荒萊不闢，督課無聞。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Of late agriculture and sericulture have slackened; idlers who wander for food are many; fallow waste is not opened, and overseers' assessments go unheard.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Of late farming and sericulture have languished; wanderers living off others are numerous; wasteland lies unreclaimed, and supervisory duties go unreported.

sentences.zh: 一時水旱，便有罄匱，苟不深存務本，[9]豐給靡因。

translations.literal: When drought or flood strikes for a season, exhaustion follows at once; if one does not deeply hold to the fundamental work, [9] abundance cannot be had.
translations.idiomatic: A single season of flood or drought brings destitution; unless the fundamental work of the land is deeply upheld, [9] plenty cannot be secured.

sentences.zh: 郡守賦政方畿，縣宰親民之主，宜思奬訓，導以良規。

translations.literal: Prefects administer government in the capital region; magistrates are lords close to the people—they should ponder encouragement and instruction, guiding them with good rules.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects govern the metropolitan districts; magistrates are masters closest to the people—they should reflect on how to encourage and instruct them, guiding them with sound policies.

sentences.zh: 咸使肆力，地無遺利，耕蠶樹藝，各盡其力。

translations.literal: All should be made to exert their strength so no land is left unused; in plowing, silk culture, and planting each should give full effort.
translations.idiomatic: All should be set to their labor so that no land lies idle; in plowing, sericulture, and planting each should give full effort.

sentences.zh: 若有力田殊眾，歲竟條名列上。

translations.literal: If any have exceptional diligence in the fields, at year's end list and report them upward."
translations.idiomatic: Those with outstanding achievement in cultivation should, when the year ends, be listed by name and reported upward."

sentences.zh: 」揚州旱。

translations.literal: Yang Province suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Province suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣侍御史省獄訟，申調役。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, attendant censors were sent to review prison cases and adjust corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, attendant censors were dispatched to review prison cases and adjust corvée obligations.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以左軍諮議參軍劉道產為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, Liu Daochan, Consulting Colonel of the Left Army, was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Liu Daochan, Consulting Colonel of the Left Army, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲辰，臨川王義慶解尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day in the eighth month of autumn, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing resigned as Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day in the eighth month of autumn, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing resigned as Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，割豫州秦郡屬南兗州。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, Qin commandery of Yu Province was attached to Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Qin commandery in Yu Province was placed under Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，罷湘州還并荊州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, Xiang Province was abolished and merged back into Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, Xiang Province was abolished and reincorporated into Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 九年春三月庚戌，衞將軍王弘進位太保，加中書監。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the third month in spring of the ninth year, Wang Hong, General of the Guard, was advanced to Grand Tutor with the additional post of Supervisor of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the third month in spring of the ninth year, General of the Guard Wang Hong was promoted to Grand Tutor and additionally appointed Supervisor of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，征南大將軍、江州刺史檀道濟進位司空。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns South and Governor of Jiang Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns South and Governor of Jiang Province, was promoted to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，以護軍將軍殷穆為特進、右光祿大夫，建昌縣公到彥之為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the yihai day in the fourth month of summer, Yin Mu, General Who Protects the Army, was made Special Grandee and Right Grandee of Splendid Virtue; Dao Yanzhi, Duke of Jianchang, was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day in the fourth month of summer, Yin Mu, General Who Protects the Army, was made Special Grandee and Right Grandee of Splendid Virtue; Dao Yanzhi, Duke of Jianchang, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，中書監、錄尚書事、衞將軍、揚州刺史王弘薨。

translations.literal: On the renshen day of the fifth month, Wang Hong, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, General of the Guard, and Governor of Yang Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the fifth month, Wang Hong, Supervisor and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, General of the Guard, and Governor of Yang Province, died.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，以左軍諮議參軍申宣為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the sixth month, Shen Xuan, Consulting Colonel of the Left Army, was made Inspector of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the sixth month, Shen Xuan, Consulting Colonel of the Left Army, was appointed Inspector of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 分青州置冀州。

translations.literal: Ji Province was established by partitioning Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Province was established by partitioning Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，司徒、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改領揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Minister over the Masses and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was changed to Governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Minister over the Masses and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以司徒參軍崔諲為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, Cui Yin, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was made Inspector of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Cui Yin, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was appointed Inspector of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍，[10]吐谷渾拾虔為平北將軍，吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, Murong Yan of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the East; [10] Shiqian of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the North; and Huifa of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Garrisons the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Murong Yan of the Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the East; [10] Shiqian of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the North; and Huifa of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Garrisons the Army.

sentences.zh: [11]癸未，詔曰：「益、梁、交、廣，境域幽遐，治宜物情，或多偏擁。

translations.literal: [11] An edict said: "Yi, Liang, Jiao, and Guang—their territories are remote and far; governance should suit local conditions, yet in many places partial monopolies prevail.
translations.idiomatic: [11] An edict said: "Yi, Liang, Jiao, and Guang lie in distant borderlands; administration should accord with local conditions, yet in many places power is held in narrow, selfish hands.

sentences.zh: 可更遣大使，巡求民瘼。

translations.literal: Great envoys may again be dispatched to tour and seek the people's afflictions."
translations.idiomatic: Let great envoys again be sent forth to tour the regions and inquire into the people's hardships."

sentences.zh: 」置積射、強弩將軍官。

translations.literal: The offices of General of Volley-Shooters and General of Strong Crossbows were established.
translations.idiomatic: The posts of General of Volley-Shooters and General of Strong Crossbows were established.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以征西將軍、沙州刺史吐谷渾慕容璝為征西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史、隴西王。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, Murong Gui of the Tuyuhun, General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Shazhou, was made General Who Campaigns West, Governor of Western Qin and He provinces, and Prince of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Murong Gui of the Tuyuhun, General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Shazhou, was appointed General Who Campaigns West, Governor of Western Qin and He provinces, and Prince of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 北秦州刺史氐楊難當加號征西將軍。

translations.literal: Yang Nandang, Inspector of Northern Qin Province of the Di, was given the additional title General Who Campaigns West.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Nandang of the Di, Inspector of Northern Qin Province, was additionally granted the title General Who Campaigns West.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以撫軍將軍、荊州刺史江夏王義恭為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，前將軍臨川王義慶為平西將軍、荊州刺史，南兗州刺史竟陵王義宣為中書監、中軍將軍，征虜將軍衡陽王義季為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was made General Who Campaigns North with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes and Governor of Southern Yan Province; Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Front, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province; Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General of the Central Army; and Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns North with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes and Governor of Southern Yan Province; Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Front, became General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province; Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General of the Central Army; and Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，以尚書王仲德為鎮北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day in the seventh month of autumn, Wang Zhongde of the Masters of Writing was made General Who Garrisons the North and Inspector of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day in the seventh month of autumn, Wang Zhongde of the Masters of Writing was appointed General Who Garrisons the North and Inspector of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以領軍將軍殷景仁為尚書僕射，太子詹事劉湛為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, Yin Jingren, General Who Leads the Army, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Liu Zhan, Grand Master of the Heir Apparent, was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, General Who Leads the Army Yin Jingren was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Liu Zhan, Grand Master of the Heir Apparent, was made General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 壬申，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, the state of Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

translations.literal: Editorial note twelve in the received text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note twelve marks a commentary insertion in the received text at this point.

sentences.zh: 九月，妖賊趙廣寇益州，陷沒郡縣，州府討平之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the demonic rebel Zhao Guang raided Yi Province, capturing commanderies and counties; the provincial headquarters suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the sorcerer-rebel Zhao Guang raided Yi Province, overrunning commanderies and counties; the provincial government defeated and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬子，以少府甄法崇為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the eleventh month of winter, Zhen Fachong, Director of the Palace Treasury, was made Governor of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the eleventh month of winter, Zhen Fachong, Director of the Palace Treasury, was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，於廣州立宋康郡。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, the commandery of Songkang was established in Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the commandery of Songkang was established in Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，以右軍參軍李秀之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the chia-hsü day of the twelfth month, Li Hsiu-chih, Staff Officer of the Right Army, was made Governor of Chiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the chia-hsü day of the twelfth month, Li Hsiu-chih, Staff Officer of the Right Army, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立第五皇子紹為廬陵王，江夏王義恭子朗為南豐縣王。

translations.literal: On the keng-yin day, the fifth imperial son Shao was established as Prince of Lu-ling, and Lang, son of Prince of Chiang-hsia I-chung, as Prince of Nan-feng County.
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-yin day, the fifth imperial son Shao was created Prince of Lu-ling, and Lang, son of Prince of Chiang-hsia I-chung, was created Prince of Nan-feng County.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月甲寅，竟陵王義宣改封南譙王。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on the chia-yin day, Prince of Ching-ling I-hsuan was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Nan-ch'iao.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on the chia-yin day, Prince of Ching-ling I-hsuan was redesignated Prince of Nan-ch'iao.

sentences.zh: 鎮北將軍、徐州刺史王仲德加領兗州刺史，淮南太守段宏為青州刺史。

translations.literal: Wang Chung-te, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsü Province, was additionally made Governor of Yen Province; Tuan Hung, Administrator of Huai-nan, was made Governor of Ch'ing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chung-te, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsü Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Yen Province; Tuan Hung, Administrator of Huai-nan, became Governor of Ch'ing Province.

sentences.zh: 己未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the chi-wei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-wei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 後將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣進號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: I-hsin, Prince of Ch'ang-sha and General of the Rear and Governor of Yü Province, was advanced in title to General of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Ch'ang-sha I-hsin, General of the Rear and Governor of Yü Province, was advanced to General of the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，青州刺史段宏加冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wu-hsü day of the fourth month in summer, Tuan Hung, Governor of Ch'ing Province, was additionally made Governor of Chi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-hsü day of the fourth month in summer, Tuan Hung, Governor of Ch'ing Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Chi Province.

sentences.zh: 封陽縣侯蕭思話為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: Hsiao Szu-hua, Marquis of Feng-yang, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Hsiao Szu-hua, Marquis of Feng-yang, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.

sentences.zh: 五月，林邑王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the King of Lin-yi sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the King of Lin-yi sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，以前青州刺史韋朗為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the i-hai day of the sixth month, Wei Lang, former Governor of Ch'ing Province, was made Governor of Kuang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the i-hai day of the sixth month, Wei Lang, former Governor of Ch'ing Province, was appointed Governor of Kuang Province.

sentences.zh: 闍婆州訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The state of Ho-lo-tan in Ch'an-p'o sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Ho-lo-tan in Ch'an-p'o sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，曲赦益、梁、秦三州。

translations.literal: On the wu-hsü day of the seventh month in autumn, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yi, Liang, and Ch'in provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-hsü day of the seventh month in autumn, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yi, Liang, and Ch'in provinces.

sentences.zh: 於益州立宋寧、宋興二郡。

translations.literal: The commanderies of Sung-ning and Sung-hsing were established in Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies of Sung-ning and Sung-hsing were established in Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，於青州立太原郡。

translations.literal: On the ting-ch'ou day of the eighth month, T'ai-yüan Commandery was established in Ch'ing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-ch'ou day of the eighth month, T'ai-yüan Commandery was established in Ch'ing Province.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，護軍將軍到彥之卒。

translations.literal: On the hsin-ssu day, Tao Yen-chih, General Who Protects the Army, died.
