translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-mao day of the second month, Liu Yipin, General of the Left Guard, was appointed Governor of Southern Yen Province.

sentences.zh: 三月，索虜寇兗、豫，青、冀刺史申恬破之。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Suolu raided Yen and Yu provinces; Shen T'ien, Governor of Ch'ing and Chi provinces, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Suolu raided Yen and Yu provinces; Shen T'ien, Governor of Ch'ing and Chi provinces, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the ting-wei day of the fourth month in summer, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-wei day of the fourth month in summer, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the kuei-wei day, the first of the sixth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-wei day, the first of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 交州刺史檀和之伐林邑國，剋之。

translations.literal: Tan Ho-chih, Governor of Chiao Province, attacked the state of Lin-yi and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Ho-chih, Governor of Chiao Province, attacked the state of Lin-yi and captured it.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，以散騎常侍杜坦為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the hsin-wei day of the seventh month in autumn, Tu T'an, Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, was made Governor of Ch'ing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-wei day of the seventh month in autumn, Tu T'an, Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, was appointed Governor of Ch'ing Province.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，揭陽赭賊攻建安郡，燔燒城府。

translations.literal: On the kuei-mao day of the eighth month, the ochre rebels of Chieh-yang attacked Chien-an commandery and burned the government offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-mao day of the eighth month, the ochre rebels of Chieh-yang attacked Chien-an commandery and burned the government offices.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，車駕幸國子學，策試諸生，答問凡五十九人。

translations.literal: On the chi-mao day of the ninth month, the imperial carriage visited the Imperial Academy; the students were examined by question and answer, fifty-nine persons in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-mao day of the ninth month, the emperor visited the Imperial Academy; the students were examined in question and answer, fifty-nine in all.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，詔曰：「庠序興立累載，冑子肄業有成。

translations.literal: On the wu-tzu day in the tenth month of winter, an edict said: "The schools have been established for many years, and the sons of officials have completed their studies.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-tzu day in the tenth month of winter, an edict said: "The schools have stood for many years, and the sons of officials have completed their studies.

sentences.zh: 近親策試，覩濟濟之美，緬想洙、泗，永懷在昔。

translations.literal: Having recently witnessed them in close examination, I beheld their flourishing excellence and, gazing back to Chu and Ssu, ever cherish the past.
translations.idiomatic: Having recently examined them at close hand, I beheld their flourishing excellence and, looking back to the age of Chu and Ssu, cherish the past.

sentences.zh: 諸生答問，多可採覽。

translations.literal: The students' answers to questions are in large part fit to be read.
translations.idiomatic: The students' answers are for the most part fit to be read with profit.

sentences.zh: 教授之官，並宜沾賚。

translations.literal: The instructors are all to receive rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Their instructors are all to receive rewards.

sentences.zh: 」賜帛各有差。

translations.literal: " Silk was granted in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: " Silk was granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，以龍驤司馬蕭景憲為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the ting-yu day of the twelfth month, Hsiao Ching-hsien, Marshal of Dragon Celerity, was made Governor of Chiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-yu day of the twelfth month, Hsiao Ching-hsien, Marshal of Dragon Celerity, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大有年。

translations.literal: That year, the harvest was greatly abundant.
translations.idiomatic: That year brought a great harvest.

sentences.zh: 築北堤，立玄武湖，築景陽山於華林園。

translations.literal: The northern embankment was built, Hsuan-wu Lake was established, and Ching-yang Mountain was constructed in the Hua-lin Park.
translations.idiomatic: The northern embankment was built, Hsuan-wu Lake was established, and Ching-yang Mountain was raised in the Hua-lin Park.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月甲戌，大赦天下，文武賜位一等。

translations.literal: On the chia-hsü day of the first month of spring of the twenty-fourth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On the chia-hsü day of the first month of spring of the twenty-fourth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 繫囚降宥，諸逋負寬減各有差。

translations.literal: Imprisoned convicts were pardoned with reduced sentences; all overdue obligations were leniently reduced in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Imprisoned convicts received reduced sentences; all overdue obligations were leniently reduced in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 蠲建康、秣陵二縣今年田租之半。

translations.literal: Half of this year's land tax for Chien-k'ang and Mu-ling counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Half of this year's land tax for Chien-k'ang and Mu-ling counties was remitted.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，護軍將軍趙伯符遷職。

translations.literal: On the jen-shên day of the third month, Chao Po-fu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred to another post.
translations.idiomatic: On the jen-shên day of the third month, Chao Po-fu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred to another post.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲戌，青州刺史杜坦加冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On the chia-hsü day of the fifth month in summer, Tu T'an, Governor of Ch'ing Province, was additionally made Governor of Chi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the chia-hsü day of the fifth month in summer, Tu T'an, Governor of Ch'ing Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Chi Province.

sentences.zh: 六月，京邑疫癘，丙戌，使郡縣及營署部司，普加履行，給以醫藥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, pestilence struck the capital; on the ping-hsü day, the commanderies, counties, and supervising offices of the camps and garrisons were all ordered to tour widely and supply medicine.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, pestilence struck the capital; on the ping-hsü day, the commanderies, counties, and supervising offices of the camps and garrisons were ordered to tour widely and supply medicine.

sentences.zh: 是月，以貨貴，制大錢一當兩。

translations.literal: That month, because goods were dear, large coins were instituted at the value of two.
translations.idiomatic: That month, because goods were dear, large coins were instituted at a value of two.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，以林邑所獲金銀寶物，班賚各有差。

translations.literal: On the i-mao day of the seventh month in autumn, the gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Lin-yi were distributed as rewards in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the i-mao day of the seventh month in autumn, the gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Lin-yi were distributed as rewards in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，征北大將軍、徐州刺史衡陽王義季薨。

translations.literal: On the i-wei day of the eighth month, Prince of Heng-yang Yichi, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Hsu Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the i-wei day of the eighth month, Prince of Heng-yang Yichi, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Hsu Province, died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以南兗州刺史劉義賓為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the kuei-mao day, Liu Yipin, Governor of Southern Yen Province, was made Governor of Hsu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-mao day, Liu Yipin, Governor of Southern Yen Province, was appointed Governor of Hsu Province.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，以中領軍沈演之為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the chi-wei day of the ninth month, Shen Yen-chih, General Who Leads the Army in the Interior, was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-wei day of the ninth month, Shen Yen-chih, General Who Leads the Army in the Interior, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以太子詹事徐湛之為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the hsin-wei day, Hsu Chan-chih, Grandee Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Governor of Southern Yen Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-wei day, Hsu Chan-chih, Grandee Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Governor of Southern Yen Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，豫章胡誕世反，殺太守桓隆之，前交州刺史檀和之南還至豫章，因討平之。

translations.literal: On the jen-wu day in the tenth month of winter, Hu Tan-shih of Yu-chang rebelled and killed the Administrator Huan Lung-chih; Tan Ho-chih, former Governor of Chiao Province, returning south reached Yu-chang and thereupon suppressed the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jen-wu day in the tenth month of winter, Hu Tan-shih of Yu-chang rebelled and killed the Administrator Huan Lung-chih; Tan Ho-chih, former Governor of Chiao Province, on his return south reached Yu-chang and thereupon suppressed the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以建平王宏為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the jen-ch'en day, Prince of Chien-p'ing Hung was made General of the Central Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the jen-ch'en day, Prince of Chien-p'ing Hung was appointed General of the Central Guard.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，立第十皇子渾為汝陰王。

translations.literal: On the chia-yin day of the eleventh month, the tenth imperial son Hun was established as Prince of Ju-yin.
translations.idiomatic: On the chia-yin day of the eleventh month, the tenth imperial son Hun was created Prince of Ju-yin.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月戊辰，詔曰：「比者冰雪經旬，薪粒貴踊，貧弊之室，多有窘罄。

translations.literal: On the wu-ch'en day of the first month of spring of the twenty-fifth year, an edict said: "Recently ice and snow have lasted for ten days; fuel and grain have soared in price, and poor and destitute households are in many cases reduced to utter want.
translations.idiomatic: On the wu-ch'en day of the first month of spring of the twenty-fifth year, an edict said: "Recently ice and snow have lasted ten days on end; fuel and grain have soared in price, and poor and destitute households are in many cases reduced to utter want.

sentences.zh: 可檢行京邑二縣及營署，賜以柴米。」

translations.literal: Let the two capital counties and the camps and garrisons be inspected, and fuel and grain granted."
translations.idiomatic: Let the two capital counties and the camps and garrisons be inspected, and fuel and grain granted."

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，詔曰：「安不忘虞，經世之所同；

translations.literal: On the keng-yin day of the second month, an edict said: "In security one must not forget peril—this is what governs the age;
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-yin day of the second month, an edict said: "In security one must not forget peril—this is what governs the age;

sentences.zh: 治兵教戰，有國之恒典。

translations.literal: to train the army and teach warfare is the constant statute of a state.
translations.idiomatic: to train the army and teach warfare is the constant statute of a state.

sentences.zh: 故服訓明恥，然後少長知禁。

translations.literal: Therefore, having received instruction and knowing shame, young and old alike learn restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, having received instruction and knowing shame, young and old alike learn restraint.

sentences.zh: 頃戎政雖修，而號令未審。

translations.literal: Recently military affairs have indeed been cultivated, yet the commands have not been made clear.
translations.idiomatic: Recently military affairs have indeed been cultivated, yet the commands have not been made clear.

sentences.zh: 今宣武場始成，便可剋日大習眾軍。

translations.literal: Now that the Hsuan-wu training ground has been completed, a great review of the armies may be set for a fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Hsuan-wu training ground has been completed, a great review of the armies may be set for a fixed day.

sentences.zh: 當因校獵，肄武講事。」

translations.literal: It shall take place in conjunction with the hunt review, to drill the troops and discuss affairs of war."
translations.idiomatic: It shall take place in conjunction with the hunt review, to drill the troops and discuss affairs of war."

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，大蒐于宣武場。

translations.literal: On the chi-yu day of the intercalary month, a grand hunt was held at the Hsuan-wu training ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-yu day of the intercalary month, a grand hunt was held at the Hsuan-wu training ground.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，車駕校獵。

translations.literal: On the keng-ch'en day of the third month, the imperial carriage conducted a hunt review.
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-ch'en day of the third month, the emperor conducted a hunt review.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，新作閶闔、廣莫二門，改先廣莫門曰承明，開陽曰津陽。

translations.literal: On the i-ssu day of the fourth month in summer, the new Ch'ang-k'o and Kuang-mo gates were built; the former Kuang-mo gate was renamed Ch'eng-ming, and K'ai-yang was renamed Chin-yang.
translations.idiomatic: On the i-ssu day of the fourth month in summer, the new Ch'ang-k'o and Kuang-mo gates were built; the former Kuang-mo gate was renamed Ch'eng-ming, and K'ai-yang was renamed Chin-yang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以撫軍將軍、雍州刺史武陵王駿為安北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the i-mao day, Prince of Wu-ling Chun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yung Province, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the i-mao day, Prince of Wu-ling Chun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yung Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsu Province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以右衞將軍蕭思話為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the kuei-hai day, Hsiao Ssu-hua, General of the Right Guard, was made Governor of Yung Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the kuei-hai day, Hsiao Ssu-hua, General of the Right Guard, was appointed Governor of Yung Province.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，罷大錢當兩。

translations.literal: On the chi-mao day of the fifth month, large coins at the value of two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-mao day of the fifth month, large coins at a value of two were abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，零陵王司馬元瑜薨。

translations.literal: On the keng-hsü day of the sixth month, Ssu-ma Yüan-yü, Marshal of Ling-ling, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-hsü day of the sixth month, Ssu-ma Yüan-yü, Marshal of Ling-ling, died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，安北將軍、徐州刺史武陵王駿加兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the keng-shên day, Prince of Wu-ling Chun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsu Province, was additionally made Governor of Yen Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-shên day, Prince of Wu-ling Chun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsu Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Yen Province.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車騎將軍、荊州刺史南譙王義宣進位司空。

translations.literal: On the ping-yin day, Prince of Nan-ch'iao Yihsuan, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Ching Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the ping-yin day, Prince of Nan-ch'iao Yihsuan, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Ching Province, was promoted to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，左光祿大夫王敬弘薨。

translations.literal: On the jen-wu day of the seventh month in autumn, Wang Ching-hung, Grandee of the Left with the Golden Tassel, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jen-wu day of the seventh month in autumn, Wang Ching-hung, Grandee of the Left with the Golden Tassel, died.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以撫軍參軍劉秀之為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the chi-yu day of the eighth month, Liu Hsiu-chih, Staff Officer of the General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-yu day of the eighth month, Liu Hsiu-chih, Staff Officer of the General Who Pacifies the Army, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲子，立第十一皇子彧為淮陽王。

translations.literal: On the chia-tzu day, the eleventh imperial son Yü was established as Prince of Huai-yang.
translations.idiomatic: On the chia-tzu day, the eleventh imperial son Yü was created Prince of Huai-yang.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以尚書右僕射何尚之為尚書左僕射，領軍將軍沈演之遷職，吳興太守劉遵考為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the hsin-wei day of the ninth month, Ho Shang-chih, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Shen Yen-chih, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred to another post; Liu Tsun-k'ao, Administrator of Wu-hsing, was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-wei day of the ninth month, Ho Shang-chih, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Shen Yen-chih, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred to another post; and Liu Tsun-k'ao, Administrator of Wu-hsing, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On the hsin-ssu day of the first month of spring of the twenty-sixth year, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the hsin-ssu day of the first month of spring of the twenty-sixth year, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，車駕陸道幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: On the chi-hai day of the second month, the imperial carriage went by land to Tan-tu and visited the imperial tombs at Ching.
translations.idiomatic: On the chi-hai day of the second month, the emperor traveled overland to Tan-tu and visited the imperial tombs at Ching.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，[34]詔曰：「朕違北京，二十餘載，雖云密邇，瞻塗莫從。

translations.literal: On the ting-ssu day of the third month, [34] an edict said: "I have been apart from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is said to be near at hand, I have had no path by which to gaze upon the road.
translations.idiomatic: On the ting-ssu day of the third month, [34] an edict said: "I have been apart from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is said to be close at hand, I have had no way to look upon the road thither.

sentences.zh: 今因四表無塵，時和歲稔，復獲拜奉舊塋，展罔極之思，饗讌故老，申追遠之懷。

translations.literal: Now because the four quarters are without dust, the seasons harmonious and the years abundant, I have again been able to pay homage at the old tombs, extend boundless filial thought, feast and entertain the elders of old, and express the heart that reaches back to the distant past.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the four quarters are untroubled, the seasons mild, and the harvests full, I have again been able to pay homage at the ancestral tombs, give full scope to boundless filial devotion, feast the old men of the district, and voice the grief that looks back to those gone before.

sentences.zh: 固以義兼於桑梓，情加於過沛，永言慷慨，感慰實深。

translations.literal: Thus righteousness joins with the native place, and feeling is added upon passing Pei; words ever stirring, gratitude and consolation are truly deep.
translations.idiomatic: Thus my duty to the homeland and my affection for Pei alike move me; long do I speak of it with feeling, and my gratitude and comfort are profound.

sentences.zh: 宜聿宣仁惠，覃被率土。

translations.literal: It is fitting to proclaim benevolence and favor far and wide, extending over all the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolence and grace should now be proclaimed abroad and spread throughout the land.

sentences.zh: 其大赦天下。

translations.literal: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty is proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 復丹徒縣僑舊今歲租布之半。

translations.literal: Remit half of this year's rent-cloth from the displaced old families of Dantu County.
translations.idiomatic: Half of this year's rent-cloth levy on the displaced old families of Dantu County is remitted.

sentences.zh: 行所經縣，蠲田租之半。

translations.literal: In counties passed through on the journey, remit half the field rent.
translations.idiomatic: In every county along the imperial route, half the field rent is remitted.

sentences.zh: 二千石官長並勤勞王務，宜有沾錫。

translations.literal: The chief officials of the two-thousand-dan rank who have all toiled at royal affairs should share in the bounty.
translations.idiomatic: The chief officials of two-thousand-dan rank who have labored diligently in the king's service should likewise receive a share of the bounty.

sentences.zh: 登城三戰及大將戰亡墜沒之家，老病單弱者，普加贍卹。

translations.literal: Families of those who fell in the three battles at Dengcheng and of great generals killed or lost in battle—the aged, ill, and weak living alone—are all to receive general relief and support.
translations.idiomatic: Households of men lost in the three battles at Dengcheng and of great generals killed or missing in war, together with the aged, sick, and destitute living alone, are all to receive general relief.

sentences.zh: 遣使巡行百姓，問所疾苦。

translations.literal: Send envoys to tour among the people and inquire into their hardships.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to tour the districts and inquire into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 孤老、鰥寡、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: The orphaned aged, widowers and widows, and sufferers of the six ailments who cannot support themselves—each is granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: The solitary aged, widowers and widows, and those afflicted with the six crippling disorders who cannot support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 」遣使祭晉故司空忠肅公何無忌之墓。

translations.literal: " Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tomb of He Wuji, late Jin Excellency of Works, styled Loyal and Solemn.
translations.idiomatic: " Envoys were sent to offer sacrifice at the tomb of He Wuji, former Jin Excellency of Works, posthumously styled Loyal and Solemn.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，申南北沛下邳三郡復。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, the three commanderies of Nanbei Pei and Xiapi were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the three commanderies of Nanbei Pei and Xiapi were granted tax remission.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「京口肇祥自古，著符近代，衿帶江山，表裏華甸，經塗四達，利盡淮、海，城邑高明，土風淳壹，苞總形勝，實唯名都。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "Jingkou has borne auspicious signs since antiquity and received their confirmation in recent times; girdled by rivers and mountains, within and without it lies the heartland of splendor; roads run four ways, and profit reaches to the Huai and the sea; its cities and towns are lofty and bright, its local customs pure and uniform; gathering all strategic advantages, it is truly a famous capital.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "Jingkou has been a place of auspicious beginnings since antiquity and received its confirmation in recent times. Girdled by rivers and mountains, it is the heartland's inner and outer gate; roads run in every direction, and its advantages reach the Huai and the sea. Its towns are lofty, its customs pure and uniform; gathering every strategic strength, it is truly a capital of renown.

sentences.zh: 故能光宅靈心，克昌帝業。

translations.literal: Thus it was able to illumine and settle the imperial heart and bring the imperial enterprise to flourishing completion.
translations.idiomatic: Thus it could illumine the imperial mind and bring the imperial enterprise to full flourishing.

sentences.zh: 頃年岳牧遷回，軍民徙散，廛里廬宇，不逮往日。

translations.literal: In recent years the provincial governors have shifted back and forth, soldiers and civilians have scattered in migration, and the lanes and dwellings no longer match former days.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the provincial governors have come and gone, soldiers and civilians have scattered, and the streets and houses no longer match what they once were.

sentences.zh: 皇基舊鄉，地兼蕃重，宜令殷阜，式崇形望。

translations.literal: The old homeland of the imperial foundation, its territory both strategically weighty—should be made prosperous and abundant, and its outward prestige exalted.
translations.idiomatic: The old homeland of the dynastic foundation, a region of strategic weight, should be made prosperous and its outward prestige exalted.

sentences.zh: 可募諸州樂移者數千家，給以田宅，并蠲復。」

translations.literal: Several thousand households willing to relocate from the various provinces may be recruited, given fields and dwellings, and granted remission and restoration."
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand households from the provinces willing to relocate may be recruited, granted fields and dwellings, and given remission of levies and restoration of status."

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，詔曰：「吾生於此城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingyin day, an edict said: "I was born in this city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingyin day, an edict said: "I was born in this city.

sentences.zh: 及盧循肆亂，害流茲境。

translations.literal: When Lu Xun ran riot, harm flowed through this region.
translations.idiomatic: When Lu Xun rose in rebellion, calamity swept this region.

sentences.zh: 先帝以桑梓根本，實同休戚，復以蒙稚，猥同艱難，情義繾綣，夷險兼備，舊物遺蹤，猶存心目。

translations.literal: The late Emperor, because the native place is the root, truly shared weal and woe; again because I was young and tender, unworthily shared hardship with him; affection intimate, through peace and peril alike; traces of old things still remain before the eyes.
translations.idiomatic: The late Emperor, holding the native place as the root, truly shared its fortune and misfortune; and I, though young and tender, unworthily shared his hardships. Our bond was intimate through peace and peril alike, and traces of the old days still live in memory.

sentences.zh: 歲月不居，逝踰三紀，時人故老，與運零落。

translations.literal: The years do not tarry; more than three decades have passed; the men of the time and the elders of old have fallen away with fate.
translations.idiomatic: The years do not wait; more than three decades have passed, and the men of that time and the elders of old have vanished with the turning of fate.

sentences.zh: 眷惟既往，倍深感歎。

translations.literal: Looking back upon what is past, I am doubly moved to deep sighing.
translations.idiomatic: Looking back on what is past, I am doubly moved to deep sighing.

sentences.zh: 可搜訪于時士庶文武今尚存者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Search out civil and military gentlemen and commoners of that time who still survive today, and report all their names.
translations.idiomatic: Search out the civil and military officers and commoners of that time who still survive, and report all their names.

sentences.zh: 人身已亡而子孫見在，優量賜賚之。

translations.literal: Where the person himself is dead but descendants still live, generously measure out rewards and gifts to them.
translations.idiomatic: Where the person himself is dead but descendants remain, generously measure out rewards and gifts to them.

sentences.zh: 」車駕水路發丹徒，壬午，至京師。

translations.literal: " The imperial carriage set out by water from Dantu; on the renwu day, it reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: " The imperial carriage set out by water from Dantu; on the renwu day it reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，婆皇國，壬辰，婆達國，並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, the state of Bohuang; on the renchen day, the state of Boda—both sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Bohuang; on the renchen day, Boda—each sent envoys bearing local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，以江州刺史廬陵王紹為南徐州刺史，廣陵王誕為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinwei day, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Jiang Province, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province; Prince of Guangling Dan was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinwei day, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province, and Prince of Guangling Dan was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以中護軍建平王宏為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Prince of Pingcheng Hong, General of the Household Guards, was made Governor of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Prince of Pingcheng Hong, General of the Household Guards, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以南豐王朗為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was made Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，廣陵王誕改封隨郡王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was enfeoffed as Prince of Sui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was enfeoffed as Prince of Sui Commandery.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史始興王濬為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐兗二州刺史，南徐州刺史廬陵王紹為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General of the Central Army and Governor of Yang Province, was made General Who Campaigns North, with the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, and Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made Governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General of the Central Army and Governor of Yang Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns North, granted the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, and made Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Southern Xu Province, became Governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月辛未，制交、寧二州假板郡縣，俸祿聽依臺除。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-seventh year, on the xinwei day, provisional commandery and county appointments in Jiao and Ning provinces were regulated; salaries were to follow metropolitan appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-seventh year, on the xinwei day, provisional commandery and county appointments in Jiao and Ning provinces were regulated, and salaries were ordered to follow metropolitan standards.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, the state of Paekche sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Paekche sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，右將軍、豫州刺史南平王鑠進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day of the second month, Prince of Nanping Shuo, General of the Right and Governor of Yu Province, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the second month, Prince of Nanping Shuo, General of the Right and Governor of Yu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，[35]索虜寇汝南諸郡，陳南頓二郡太守鄭琨、汝陽潁川二郡太守郭道隱委守走。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, [35] the Suo raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of the two commanderies of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of the two commanderies of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, [35] the Suo raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.

sentences.zh: 索虜攻懸瓠城，行汝南郡事陳憲拒之。

translations.literal: The Suo attacked Xuancheng; Chen Xian, acting in the affairs of Runan Commandery, resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: The Suo attacked Xuancheng; Chen Xian, acting Administrator of Runan, resisted them.

sentences.zh: 以軍興減百官俸三分之一。

translations.literal: Because of the military emergency, the salaries of the hundred officials were reduced by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: Because of the military emergency, the salaries of all officials were reduced by one-third.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，淮南太守諸葛闡求減俸祿同內百官，於是州及郡縣丞尉並悉同減。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Kan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced in the same manner as the metropolitan officials; thereupon the assistants, clerks, and constables of provinces, commanderies, and counties were all likewise reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Kan, Administrator of Huainan, asked that salaries be cut to match those of metropolitan officials; thereupon assistants, clerks, and constables throughout provinces, commanderies, and counties were all reduced alike.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷國子學。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, the Imperial University was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the Imperial University was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以新除吏部尚書蕭思話為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，安北將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the renzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General Who Pacifies the Army.

translations.literal: Editorial note thirty-six in the received text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note thirty-six marks a commentary insertion in the received text at this point.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，侍中蕭斌為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day of the sixth month, Xiao Bin, Palace Attendant, was made Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the sixth month, Xiao Bin, Palace Attendant, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，遣寧朔將軍王玄謨北伐。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the seventh month of autumn, Ningshuo General Wang Xuanmo was dispatched on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the seventh month of autumn, Wang Xuanmo, General of Ningshuo, was dispatched on the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 太尉江夏王義恭出次彭城，總統諸軍。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong went out and encamped at Pengcheng, commanding all the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong advanced and encamped at Pengcheng, taking overall command of the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，索虜碻磝戍委城走。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the Suo garrison at Qiepo abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the Suo garrison at Qiepo abandoned the city and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 冬閏月癸亥，玄謨攻滑臺，不克，為虜所敗，退還碻磝。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the intercalary month of winter, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but did not take it; he was defeated by the barbarians and withdrew to Qiepo.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the intercalary month of winter, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but failed to take it; he was defeated by the enemy and withdrew to Qiepo.

sentences.zh: 辛未，雍州刺史隨王誕遣軍攻弘農城，克之。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Prince of Sui Dan, Governor of Yong Province, dispatched troops to attack Hongnong city and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Prince of Sui Dan, Governor of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong and captured it.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，又克關城。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, Guan city was again captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Guan city was captured as well.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，索虜陷鄒山，魯、陽平二郡太守崔邪利沒。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Suo captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of the two commanderies of Lu and Yangping, was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Suo captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping, was taken captive.

sentences.zh: 甲午，隨王誕所遣軍又攻陝城，克之。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, the army dispatched by Prince of Sui Dan again attacked Shan city and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the army sent by Prince of Sui Dan again attacked Shan city and captured it.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，左軍將軍劉康祖於壽陽尉武戍與虜戰敗見殺。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left Army, was defeated in battle at Yuwu Garrison in Shouyang by the barbarians and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left Army, was defeated in battle by the enemy at Yuwu Garrison in Shouyang and was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，內外纂嚴。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, strict guard was imposed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, strict guard was imposed within and without the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，冗從僕射胡崇之、太子積弩將軍臧澄之、建威將軍毛熙祚於盱眙與虜戰敗，並見殺。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant of the Suite, Zang Cheng, General of Accumulated Crossbows for the Heir Apparent, and Mao Xizuo, General Who Establishes Might, were defeated in battle at Xuyi by the barbarians; all were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant of the Suite, Zang Cheng, General of Accumulated Crossbows for the Heir Apparent, and Mao Xizuo, General Who Establishes Might, were defeated in battle at Xuyi by the enemy and were all killed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，虜偽主率大眾至瓜步。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, the barbarian pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the barbarian pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, strict guard was imposed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, strict guard was again imposed within and without.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月丙戌朔，以寇逼不朝會。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring of the twenty-eighth year, the bingxu day of the new moon, because of the enemy's pressure there was no court assembly.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the new moon of the first month of spring of the twenty-eighth year, because of the enemy threat the court did not hold its new-year assembly.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，索虜自瓜步退走。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, the Suo withdrew from Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the Suo withdrew from Guabu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，攻圍盱眙城。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi city.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 是月，寧朔將軍王玄謨自碻磝退還歷下。

translations.literal: That month, Ningshuo General Wang Xuanmo withdrew from Qiepo and returned to Lixia.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wang Xuanmo, General of Ningshuo, withdrew from Qiepo and returned to Lixia.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，索虜自盱眙奔走。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the second month, the Suo fled in disorder from Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the second month, the Suo broke camp and fled from Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔曰：「玁狁孔熾，難及數州，眷言念之，鑒寐興悼。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun blaze fiercely, and hardship reaches several provinces; thinking of it with care, I wake and sleep in grief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun rage unchecked, and hardship reaches across several provinces; when I think of it, I cannot sleep for grief.

sentences.zh: 凶羯痍挫，迸跡遠奔，彫傷之民，宜時振理。

translations.literal: The fierce Jie are wounded and broken, scattering in flight to distant places; the people they have maimed should now be restored in timely fashion.
translations.idiomatic: The fierce foe is wounded and broken, fleeing far away; the people they have ravaged should now be restored without delay.

sentences.zh: 凡遭寇賊郡縣，令還復居業，封屍掩骼，賑贍饑流。

translations.literal: In all commanderies and counties that suffered bandit raids, order the people to return and resume their occupations; bury exposed corpses and cover bare bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced.
translations.idiomatic: In every commandery and county ravaged by the enemy, order the people to return and resume their livelihoods; bury the dead left unburied and cover the bones left bare; relieve the hungry and shelter the displaced.

sentences.zh: 東作方始，務盡勸課。

translations.literal: Spring planting is just beginning; strive to the utmost in encouraging cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Spring planting is just beginning; exert every effort in encouraging the fields.

sentences.zh: 貸給之宜，事從優厚。

translations.literal: As to the measures for lending and giving, let the matter follow generous treatment.
translations.idiomatic: As to loans and relief, let every measure be generous.

sentences.zh: 其流寓江、淮者，並聽即屬，并蠲復稅調。

translations.literal: Those who have drifted to the Yangzi and Huai regions may all be registered where they now are, and remission and restoration of levies granted."
translations.idiomatic: Those who have fled to the Yangzi and Huai regions may all be registered where they now dwell, and granted remission of taxes and corvée."

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，太尉、領司徒江夏王義恭降為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry, with the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry with the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，鎮軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號北中郎將。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General of the North Center.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General of the North Center.

sentences.zh: 壬午，車駕幸瓜步，是日解嚴。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, the imperial carriage visited Guabu; on that day strict guard was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the Emperor visited Guabu; on that day the strict guard was lifted.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the third month, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，征北將軍始興王濬解南兗州。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General Who Campaigns North, was relieved of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General Who Campaigns North, was relieved of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以輔國將軍臧質為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Zang Zhi, General Who Assists the State, was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Zang Zhi, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐州刺史武陵王駿為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xu Province, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，護軍將軍蕭思話為撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Protects the Army, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，婆達國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the fourth month of summer, the state of Boda sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the fourth month of summer, Boda sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 索虜偽寧南將軍魯爽、中書郎魯秀歸順。

translations.literal: The Suo pretender General Who Pacifies the South Lu Shuang and Secretariat Gentleman Lu Xiu submitted in allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The Suo pretender General Who Pacifies the South Lu Shuang and Secretariat Gentleman Lu Xiu came over in submission.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以爽為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Shuang was made Governor of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Shuang was appointed Governor of Si Province.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，亡命司馬順則自號齊王，據梁鄒城。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，婆皇國，戊戌，河南王，並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, the state of Bohuang; on the wuxu day, the King of Henan—both sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Bohuang; on the wuxu day, the King of Henan—each sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: [37]己巳，驃騎將軍江夏王義恭領南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: [37] On the jisi day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General of Agile Cavalry, took up the post of Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: [37] On the jisi day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General of Agile Cavalry, assumed the governorship of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以尚書左僕射何尚之為尚書令，太子詹事徐湛之為尚書僕射、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, He Shangzhi, Vice Director of the Left of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Xu Pazhi, Grandee Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, He Shangzhi, Vice Director of the Left of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing; Xu Pazhi, Grandee Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以後將軍隨王誕為安南將軍、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Prince of Sui Dan, General of the Rear, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Prince of Sui Dan, General of the Rear, was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，以北中郎將武陵王駿為江州刺史，以振武將軍、秦郡太守劉興祖為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renxu day of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun, General of the North Center, was made Governor of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, General Who Quells Martial Ardor and Administrator of Qin Commandery, was made Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun, General of the North Center, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, General Who Quells Martial Ardor and Administrator of Qin Commandery, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，安東將軍倭王倭濟進號安東大將軍。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day of the seventh month of autumn, the Wa king Wajin was advanced in title to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the seventh month of autumn, the Wa king Wajin was advanced to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，梁鄒平，斬司馬順則。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified; Sima Shunze was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the tenth month of winter, Koguryo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the tenth month of winter, Koguryo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，曲赦二兗、徐、豫、青、冀六州。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 是冬，徙彭城流民於瓜步，淮西流民於姑孰，合萬許家。

translations.literal: That winter, displaced people of Pengcheng were moved to Guabu, and displaced people west of the Huai to Gudu—together some ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, displaced people from Pengcheng were resettled at Guabu, and those from west of the Huai at Gudu—together some ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月甲午，詔曰：「經寇六州，居業未立，[38]仍值災澇，饑困荐臻。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-ninth year, on the jiawu day, an edict said: "The six provinces have suffered raids; livelihoods are not yet established; [38] they have again met with flood disaster, and hunger and distress come one upon another.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-ninth year, on the jiawu day, an edict said: "The six provinces have been ravaged by the enemy and livelihoods are not yet restored; [38] they have again suffered flooding, and hunger and distress follow in succession.

sentences.zh: 可速符諸鎮，優量救卹。

translations.literal: Speedily dispatch orders to the various garrisons and generously measure out relief and support.
translations.idiomatic: Orders should speedily go out to the various garrisons to grant generous relief.

sentences.zh: 今農事行興，務盡地利。

translations.literal: Now the agricultural work is rising; strive to the utmost in using the land's advantage.
translations.idiomatic: Spring farming is now under way; exert every effort to make full use of the land.

sentences.zh: 若須田種，隨宜給之。」

translations.literal: Where seed for the fields is needed, give it according to what is fitting."
translations.idiomatic: Where seed is needed for the fields, supply it as circumstances require."

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，虜帥拓跋燾死。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the second month, the barbarian commander Tuoba Tao died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the second month, the barbarian commander Tuoba Tao died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，[39]立第十二皇子休仁為建安王。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was established as Prince of Jian'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was created Prince of Jian'an.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the fourth month of summer, the state of Heluodan sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the fourth month of summer, Heluodan sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 以驃騎參軍張永為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong, Staff Officer to the General of Agile Cavalry, was made Governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong, Staff Officer to the General of Agile Cavalry, was appointed Governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，罷湘州并荊州。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 以始興、臨賀、始安三郡屬廣州，丙申，詔曰：「惡稔身滅，戎醜常數，虐虜窮凶，著於自昔。

translations.literal: The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were placed under Guang Province; on the bingshen day, an edict said: "When wickedness is full, the body perishes; the barbarian villain meets his constant fate; the cruel barbarian's utter depravity has been manifest since of old.
translations.idiomatic: The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were assigned to Guang Province; on the bingshen day, an edict said: "When wickedness is ripe, the man dies; the barbarian villain meets the fate that ever awaits him; the cruel enemy's utter depravity has been manifest since antiquity.

sentences.zh: 未勞資斧，已伏天誅，子孫相殘，親黨離貳，關、洛偽帥，並懷內款，河朔遺民，注誠請効。

translations.literal: Without yet troubling our axes and halberds, they have already submitted to Heaven's execution; descendants slaughter one another, kin and clans split in two; the false commanders at Kuan and Lo all harbor secret intent to submit inward, and the remnant people north of the Ho turn their loyalty and beg to serve with effect.
translations.idiomatic: Without our having yet lifted axe or halberd, Heaven's judgment has already fallen on them; their sons and grandsons slaughter one another, and kin and allies divide against each other; the puppet leaders at Kuan and Lo all secretly wish to surrender, and the people left north of the Ho fix their hearts on us and plead to be put to use.

sentences.zh: 拯溺蕩穢，今其會也。

translations.literal: To rescue the drowning and sweep away filth—now is the moment.
translations.idiomatic: To save the drowning and cleanse away corruption—now is the time.

sentences.zh: 可符驃騎、司空二府，各部分所統，東西應接。

translations.literal: Let orders be sent to the two bureaus of the Rapid Cavalry General and the Minister of Works, that each take charge of what he commands and coordinate east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Orders should go to the Rapid Cavalry General and the Minister of Works, that each division under their command respond in concert east and west.

sentences.zh: 歸義建績者，隨勞酬獎。

translations.literal: Those who submit in allegiance and establish merit shall be rewarded according to their labor.
translations.idiomatic: Those who come over in good faith and achieve merit shall be rewarded in proportion to their service.

sentences.zh: 」是月，京邑雨水。

translations.literal: " That month, the capital metropolis suffered rain and flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month the capital region was afflicted by rain and flood.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，遣部司巡行，賜樵米，給船。

translations.literal: On the sixth month, day chiyu, envoys of the ministry were dispatched to tour the districts, granting firewood and grain and providing boats.
translations.idiomatic: On chiyu day in the sixth month, ministry envoys were sent on circuit through the districts, distributing firewood and grain and supplying boats.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍蕭思話率眾北伐。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the Army Xiao Sihua led troops on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army, led an army north.

sentences.zh: 以征北從事中郎劉瑀為益州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Yu, Attendant Clerk on the Staff of the General Who Campaigns North, was made Governor of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, attendant clerk on the staff of the General Who Campaigns North, was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，汝陰王渾改封武昌王，淮陽王彧改封湘東王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jenchen day, Prince of Ju-yin Hun was redesignated Prince of Wu-ch'ang, and Prince of Huai-yang Yu was redesignated Prince of Hsiang-tung.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jenchen day, Prince of Ju-yin Hun was redesignated Prince of Wu-ch'ang, and Prince of Huai-yang Yu was redesignated Prince of Hsiang-tung.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，省大司農、太子僕、廷尉監官。

translations.literal: On the tingyu day, the posts of Supervisor of the Grand Granary, Steward of the Heir Apparent's Household, and Assistant in the Court of Justice were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the tingyu day, the offices of Supervisor of the Grand Granary, Steward of the Heir Apparent's Household, and Assistant in the Court of Justice were abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，蕭思話攻碻磝，不拔，退還。

translations.literal: On the tingmao day of the eighth month, Xiao Sihua attacked Ch'üeh-p'o but could not capture it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On tingmao day in the eighth month, Xiao Sihua attacked Ch'üeh-p'o, failed to take it, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，以平西將軍吐谷渾拾寅為安西將軍、秦河二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the tinghai day of the ninth month, Shih-yin of the Tuyuhun, General Who Pacifies the West, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Ch'in and Ho provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On tinghai day in the ninth month, Shih-yin of the Tuyuhun, General Who Pacifies the West, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Ch'in and Ho provinces.

sentences.zh: 己丑，撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史蕭思話加冀州刺史，兗州如故。

translations.literal: On the chichou day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces, was additionally made Governor of Chi Province; his governorship of Yen Province remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the chichou day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces, was additionally appointed Governor of Chi Province while retaining Yen Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，司州刺史魯爽攻虎牢不拔，退還。

translations.literal: On the kueihai day of the tenth month of winter, Lu Shuang, Inspector of Ssu Province, attacked Hu-lao but could not capture it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On kueihai day in the tenth month of winter, Lu Shuang, Inspector of Ssu Province, attacked Hu-lao, failed to take it, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，揚州刺史廬陵王紹薨。

translations.literal: On the jenyin day of the eleventh month, Shao, Prince of Lu-ling and Governor of Yang Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jen-yin day in the eleventh month, Shao, Prince of Lu-ling and Governor of Yang Province, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，以驃騎將軍、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為大將軍、南徐州刺史，錄尚書事如故。

translations.literal: On the hsinwei day of the twelfth month, Yigong, Prince of Chiang-hsia, Rapid Cavalry General and Governor of Southern Yen Province, was made Grand General and Governor of Southern Hsü Province, with Recorder of the Masters of Writing as before.
translations.idiomatic: On hsin-wei day in the twelfth month, Yigong, Prince of Chiang-hsia, Rapid Cavalry General and Governor of Southern Yen Province, was appointed Grand General and Governor of Southern Hsü Province, retaining his post as Recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月戊寅，以司空、荊州刺史南譙王義宣為司徒、中軍將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the thirtieth year, on the wuyin day, Yixuan, Prince of Nan-ch'iao, Minister of Works and Governor of Ching Province, was made Minister over the Masses, General of the Central Army, and Governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the thirtieth year, on the wu-yin day, Yixuan, Prince of Nan-ch'iao, Minister of Works and Governor of Ching Province, became Minister over the Masses, General of the Central Army, and Governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 以南兗州并南徐州。

translations.literal: Southern Yen Province was merged into Southern Hsü Province.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Yen Province was merged into Southern Hsü Province.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以領軍將軍劉遵考為平西將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the kengch'en day, Liu Tsun-k'ao, General of the Guards, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the keng-ch'en day, Liu Tsun-k'ao, General of the Guards, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以征北將軍、南徐州刺史始興王濬為衛將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jenwu day, Chun, Prince of Shih-hsing, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Hsü Province, was made General of the Guard and Governor of Ching Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jen-wu day, Chun, Prince of Shih-hsing, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Hsü Province, was appointed General of the Guard and Governor of Ching Province.

sentences.zh: 戊子，江州刺史武陵王駿統眾軍伐西陽蠻。

translations.literal: On the wutzu day, Chun, Prince of Wu-ling, commanded the armies in a campaign against the Hsi-yang barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On wu-tzu day, Chun, Prince of Wu-ling, took command of the armies to campaign against the Hsi-yang barbarians.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以豫州刺史南平王鑠為撫軍將軍、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the kueissu day, Shuo, Prince of Nan-p'ing and Inspector of Yu Province, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and General of the Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On kuei-ssu day, Shuo, Prince of Nan-p'ing and Inspector of Yu Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and General of the Guards.

sentences.zh: 青、徐州饑，二月壬子，遣運部賑卹。

translations.literal: Ch'ing and Hsü provinces suffered famine; on the jentzu day of the second month, the Transport Bureau was dispatched to grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Ch'ing and Hsü provinces suffered famine; on jen-tzu day in the second month, the Transport Bureau was sent to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上崩于含章殿。

translations.literal: On the chia-tzu day, the Emperor died in the Han-chang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On chia-tzu day, the Emperor died in the Han-chang Palace.

sentences.zh: 時年四十七。

translations.literal: He was forty-seven years old.
translations.idiomatic: He was forty-seven years old.

sentences.zh: 諡曰景皇帝，廟曰中宗。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Emperor Ching; his temple name was Chung-tsung.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Emperor Ching; his temple name was Chung-tsung.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，葬長寧陵。

translations.literal: On the kueissu day of the third month, he was buried at the Ch'ang-ning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On kuei-ssu day in the third month, he was buried at the Ch'ang-ning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 世祖踐阼，追改諡及廟號。

translations.literal: When Shih-tsu ascended the throne, he retroactively changed the posthumous title and temple name.
translations.idiomatic: When Shih-tsu came to the throne, he altered the posthumous title and temple name retroactively.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：太祖幼年特秀，顧無保傅之嚴，而天授和敏之姿，自禀君人之德。

translations.literal: The historian says: In his youth the Grand Ancestor was exceptionally gifted; though he lacked the strict tutelage of a guardian and tutor, Heaven bestowed upon him a harmonious and keen nature, and he was himself endowed with the virtue of a ruler of men.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: In youth the Grand Ancestor was singularly gifted; though he had no stern guardian or tutor, Heaven granted him a harmonious, quick mind, and he was born with the virtue of a true sovereign.

sentences.zh: 及正位南面，歷年長久，綱維備舉，條禁明密，罰有恒科，爵無濫品。

translations.literal: When he took the throne facing south, his years in power were long; the framework of government was fully established, statutes and prohibitions were clear and close, punishments had fixed measures, and ranks and titles were never bestowed without warrant.
translations.idiomatic: Once enthroned, he ruled for many years; the pillars of government stood complete, laws and prohibitions were lucid and strict, penalties followed fixed standards, and ennoblement was never careless.

sentences.zh: 故能內清外晏，四海謐如也。

translations.literal: Thus within was purity and without was peace; the four seas were tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Thus within the realm was order and without was calm; all under Heaven was still.

sentences.zh: 昔漢氏東京常稱建武、永平故事，自茲厥後，亦每以元嘉為言，斯固盛矣。

translations.literal: Formerly the Eastern Han often spoke of the precedents of Chien-wu and Yung-p'ing; after that age as well, men regularly cited the Yüan-chia reign as their model—truly this was greatness.
translations.idiomatic: In the Eastern Han men often invoked the precedents of Chien-wu and Yung-p'ing; in later times too the Yüan-chia era was held up as the standard—such was its greatness.

sentences.zh: 授將遣帥，乖分閫之命，才謝光武，而遙制兵略，至於攻日戰時，莫不仰聽成旨。

translations.literal: Yet in appointing generals and dispatching commanders he went against the proper division of frontier authority; his talent fell short of Emperor Kuang-wu's, yet he remotely controlled military strategy—so that when it came to the day of battle, none failed to look upward and obey the final order from court.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in appointing generals and sending out commanders he violated the proper division of frontier authority; his gifts were no match for Emperor Kuang-wu's, yet he directed strategy from afar—so that on the day of battle every move awaited the court's final word.

sentences.zh: 雖覆師喪旅，將非韓、白，而延寇慼境，抑此之由。

translations.literal: Though armies were shattered and hosts lost, and his generals were no Han Hsin or Pai Ch'i, the prolongation of enemy raids and grief at the borders sprang chiefly from this cause.
translations.idiomatic: Though campaigns ended in rout and commanders were no Han Hsin or Pai Ch'i, the lingering raids and border calamity owed chiefly to this.

sentences.zh: 及至言漏衾衽，難結商豎，雖禍生非慮，蓋亦有以而然也。

translations.literal: When at last word leaked beside the pillow and difficulty entangled him with a merchant of Shang, though disaster arose beyond foresight, there was reason for it to happen thus.
translations.idiomatic: When words at last leaked from the pillow and trouble bound him to a peddler of Shang, though the catastrophe was unlooked-for, it had its causes.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！

translations.literal: Alas, how lamentable!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, how lamentable!

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual collation notes

sentences.zh: 車駕至京城 孫虨宋書考論云：「當作京邑。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage reached the capital city. Sun Ao's Song Shu textual commentary says: "It should read the capital metropolis.
translations.idiomatic: "When the imperial carriage reached the capital city." Sun Ao's Song Shu textual commentary says: "It should read the capital metropolis.

sentences.zh: 京城則京口矣。

translations.literal: The capital city would then mean Ching-k'ou.
translations.idiomatic: Capital city would mean Ching-k'ou.

sentences.zh: 」按通鑑作建康。

translations.literal: " According to the Comprehensive Mirror, it reads Chien-k'ang.
translations.idiomatic: " According to the Comprehensive Mirror, the text reads Chien-k'ang.

sentences.zh: 宋書京城往往指京口城，此則指建康。

translations.literal: In the Sung shu, capital city often refers to the city of Ching-k'ou; here it refers to Chien-k'ang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Book of Song, capital city often means Ching-k'ou; here it means Chien-k'ang.

sentences.zh: 辛未車駕祠南郊 各本並脫「辛未」二字，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑補。

translations.literal: On hsin-wei the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb. All editions omit the two characters hsin-wei; they are supplied according to the History of the Southern Dynasties, the Veritable Record of Chien-k'ang, and the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: On hsin-wei the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb. All editions omit hsin-wei; the date is restored from the History of the Southern Dynasties, the Veritable Record of Chien-k'ang, and the Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅 「潘盛」各本作「潘城」，據少帝紀、徐羨之傳改。

translations.literal: Administrator of Chien-an P'an Sheng was guilty of a crime and was executed. "P'an Sheng": all editions read "P'an Ch'eng"; changed according to the Annals of the Young Emperor and the biography of Hsü Hsien-chih.
translations.idiomatic: P'an Sheng, Administrator of Chien-an, was found guilty and executed. "P'an Sheng": all editions read "P'an Ch'eng"; corrected from the Annals of the Young Emperor and the biography of Hsü Hsien-chih.

sentences.zh: 乙卯 各本並作「己卯」，據局本及南史改。

translations.literal: Yi-mao. All editions read i-mao; changed according to the Bureau edition and the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Yi-mao. All editions read i-mao; emended according to the Bureau edition and the History of the Southern Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁酉朔，十九日乙卯，無己卯。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month had new moon on ting-yu; the nineteenth day was yi-mao—there was no i-mao.
translations.idiomatic: That month's new moon fell on ting-yu; the nineteenth day was yi-mao—there was no i-mao.

sentences.zh: 領平北將軍南徐州刺史 各本並脫「南」字，按彭城王義康傳、建康實錄、通鑑並作南徐州刺史，今據補。

translations.literal: Concurrently General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Hsü Province. All editions omit the character nan; according to the biography of the Prince of P'eng-ch'eng Yikang, the Veritable Record of Chien-k'ang, and the Comprehensive Mirror, all read Governor of Southern Hsü Province—now supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Concurrently General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Hsü Province. All editions drop nan; the biography of Prince of P'eng-ch'eng Yikang, the Veritable Record of Chien-k'ang, and the Comprehensive Mirror all have Southern Hsü—restored here.

sentences.zh: 以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史 各本並脫「尹」字，按索虜傳，時尹沖為司州刺史，通鑑同。

translations.literal: Former General Who Campaigns the Barbarians Staff Officer Yin Ch'ung was made Inspector of Ssu Province. All editions omit the character Yin; according to the biography of the Northern Barbarians, at this time Yin Ch'ung was Inspector of Ssu Province, as does the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Former staff officer on the General Who Campaigns the Barbarians Yin Ch'ung was made Inspector of Ssu Province. All editions omit Yin; the Northern Barbarians biography and the Comprehensive Mirror both have Yin Ch'ung as inspector at this time.

sentences.zh: 今據補。

translations.literal: Now supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Restored accordingly.

sentences.zh: 征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張 各本並脫「平」字。

translations.literal: Grand General Who Campaigns South Tan Tao-chi defeated the Northern Barbarians at Tung-p'ing Shou-chang. All editions omit the character p'ing.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tao-chi, Grand General Who Campaigns South, defeated the Northern Barbarians at Tung-p'ing Shou-chang. All editions omit p'ing.

sentences.zh: 據檀道濟傳補。

translations.literal: Supplied according to the biography of Tan Tao-chi.
translations.idiomatic: Supplied from the biography of Tan Tao-chi.

sentences.zh: 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「按檀道濟傳作東平壽張，此『東』下脫『平』字。」

translations.literal: Hung I-hsuan's Various Histories Textual Notes says: "According to the biography of Tan Tao-chi it reads Tung-p'ing Shou-chang; here the character p'ing is missing below tung."
translations.idiomatic: Hung I-hsuan's Various Histories Textual Notes says: "The biography of Tan Tao-chi reads Tung-p'ing Shou-chang; here p'ing is missing after tung."

sentences.zh: 苟不深存務本 各本並脫「苟」字，據元龜一九八補。

translations.literal: If one does not deeply preserve the root of affairs. All editions omit the character kou; supplied according to Yuan Kuei 198.
translations.idiomatic: "If one does not deeply preserve the root of affairs." All editions omit kou; supplied from Yuan Kuei 198.

sentences.zh: 以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍 「慕容延」本書吐谷渾傳作「慕延」。

translations.literal: Mu-yen of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the East. "Mu-yen": the Tuyuhun biography in this book reads "Mu-yen."
translations.idiomatic: Mu-yen of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the East. "Mu-yen": the Tuyuhun biography in this book reads "Mu-yen."

sentences.zh: 魏書作「慕利延」。

translations.literal: The Wei shu reads "Mu Li-yen."
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Wei reads "Mu Li-yen."

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍 各本並脫「谷」字，據前後文例補。

translations.literal: Hui-fa of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Garrisons the Army. All editions omit the character ku; supplied according to the usage elsewhere in the text.
translations.idiomatic: Hui-fa of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Garrisons the Army. All editions omit ku in Tuyuhun; restored by parallel passages.

sentences.zh: 「輝伐」魏書作「緯代」。

translations.literal: "Hui-fa": the Wei shu reads "Wei-tai."
translations.idiomatic: "Hui-fa": the Book of Wei reads "Wei-tai."

sentences.zh: 壬申河南國河西王遣使獻方物 「河西王」各本作「西河王」，據少帝紀景平元年及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。

translations.literal: On jen-shen the King of Ho-nan and the King of Ho-hsi of the Ho-nan state sent envoys presenting local products. "King of Ho-hsi": all editions read "King of Hsi-ho"; changed according to the Annals of the Young Emperor for the first year of Ching-p'ing and the biography of the Great Chü-ch'ü Meng-sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jen-shen the King of Ho-nan and the King of Ho-hsi of the Ho-nan state sent envoys bearing tribute. "King of Ho-hsi": all editions read "King of Hsi-ho"; corrected from the Young Emperor annals for Ching-p'ing year 1 and the biography of Meng-sun of the Great Chü-ch'ü.

sentences.zh: 亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山 三朝本作「泰山」，弘治本、北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「秦梁」。

translations.literal: The outlaw Ma Ta-hsüan and his band of several hundred men raided T'ai-shan. The Three Dynasties edition reads "T'ai-shan"; the Hung-chih, Northern Directorate, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read "Ch'in-liang."
translations.idiomatic: The outlaw Ma Ta-hsüan and his band of several hundred raided T'ai-shan. The Three Dynasties edition reads T'ai-shan; the Hung-chih, Northern Directorate, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read Ch'in-liang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉 按是月丁亥朔，無乙酉。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day i-yu. According to the calendar, that month had new moon on ting-hai—there was no i-yu.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month of summer, i-yu day. That month's new moon was ting-hai—there was no i-yu.

sentences.zh: 二十三日己酉，「乙酉」或是「己酉」之譌。

translations.literal: The twenty-third day was chi-yu; "i-yu" is probably a corruption for "chi-yu."
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-third day was chi-yu; i-yu is probably a scribal error for chi-yu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉 「辛酉」各本並作「乙酉」，據南史改。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, hsin-yu. "Hsin-yu": all editions read "i-yu"; changed according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, hsin-yu. "Hsin-yu": all editions read i-yu; emended from the History of the Southern Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚戌朔，初六日辛酉，無「乙酉」。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month had new moon on keng-hsu; the sixth day was hsin-yu—there was no "i-yu."
translations.idiomatic: That month's new moon was keng-hsu; the sixth day was hsin-yu—there was no i-yu.

sentences.zh: 於益州立南晉壽南新巴北巴西三郡 各本並作「於益州立南晉壽新巴西三郡」。

translations.literal: In Yi Province the three commanderies of Southern Chin-shou, Southern Hsin-pa, and Northern Pa-hsi were established. All editions read "In Yi Province the three commanderies of Southern Chin-shou, Hsin-pa, and Pa-hsi were established."
translations.idiomatic: In Yi Province the three commanderies Southern Chin-shou, Southern Hsin-pa, and Northern Pa-hsi were established. All editions read "Southern Chin-shou, Hsin-pa, and Pa-hsi."

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「據州郡志，是南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。

translations.literal: Sun Ao's Song Shu textual commentary says: "According to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies, these are the three commanderies of Southern Chin-shou, Southern Hsin-pa, and Northern Pa-hsi."
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ao's Song Shu textual commentary says: "According to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies, these are Southern Chin-shou, Southern Hsin-pa, and Northern Pa-hsi."

sentences.zh: 」按孫說是，今訂正。

translations.literal: According to Sun's view this is correct; now emended.
translations.idiomatic: Sun's reading is correct; the text is emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 又此條上云「壬申」，下云「乙亥」。

translations.literal: Again, in the entry above it says "jen-shen," and below it says "i-hai."
translations.idiomatic: The line above reads jen-shen and the line below i-hai.

sentences.zh: 按是月丙戌朔，無壬申，亦無乙亥。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month had new moon on ping-hsu—there was neither jen-shen nor i-hai.
translations.idiomatic: That month's new moon was ping-hsu—neither jen-shen nor i-hai occurred.

sentences.zh: 以步兵校尉劉真道為梁南秦二州刺史 「劉真道」各本並作「劉道真」。

translations.literal: Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Chen-tao was made Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces. "Liu Chen-tao": all editions read "Liu Tao-chen."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chen-tao, Colonel of Footsoldiers, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces. "Liu Chen-tao": all editions read "Liu Tao-chen."

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「當作劉真道，見劉懷肅傳，下十八年亦作劉真道。

translations.literal: Chang Sen-k'ai's collation note says: "It should read Liu Chen-tao, as in the biography of Liu Huai-su; in the eighteenth year below it also reads Liu Chen-tao.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Sen-k'ai's collation note says: "It should be Liu Chen-tao, as in the biography of Liu Huai-su; the eighteenth year below also has Liu Chen-tao.

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Chang's view this is correct; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: " Chang's view is accepted; the text is corrected.

sentences.zh: 河南國河西王訶羅單國並遣使獻方物 「河西王」各本並作「西河王」，據少帝紀及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。

translations.literal: The King of Ho-nan and the King of Ho-hsi of the Ho-nan state, and the state of Ho-lo-tan, all sent envoys presenting local products. "King of Ho-hsi": all editions read "King of Hsi-ho"; changed according to the Annals of the Young Emperor and the biography of the Great Chü-ch'ü Meng-sun.
translations.idiomatic: The kings of Ho-nan and Ho-hsi of the Ho-nan state and the state of Ho-lo-tan all sent envoys bearing tribute. "King of Ho-hsi": all editions read "King of Hsi-ho"; corrected from the Young Emperor annals and the biography of Meng-sun of the Great Chü-ch'ü.

sentences.zh: 燕王弘遣使獻方物 「弘」各本並作「年」，據晉書載記改。

translations.literal: The King of Yen Hung sent envoys presenting local products. "Hung": all editions read "Nien"; changed according to the annals section of the Chin shu.
translations.idiomatic: King Hung of Yen sent envoys bearing tribute. "Hung": all editions read "Nien"; corrected from the annals in the Book of Chin.

sentences.zh: 今年有不收處 「年」各本並作「半」，據元龜四八九改。

translations.literal: Where this year there are districts without harvest. "Year": all editions read "half"; changed according to Yuan Kuei 489.
translations.idiomatic: "Where this year there are districts without harvest." "Year": all editions read "half"; emended from Yuan Kuei 489.

sentences.zh: 以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射 「王球」各本並作「王琳」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: Wang Ch'iu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing. "Wang Ch'iu": all editions read "Wang Lin"; changed according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ch'iu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing. "Wang Ch'iu": all editions read "Wang Lin"; corrected from the History of the Southern Dynasties and the Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「王球作王琳，是傳寫之譌。」

translations.literal: Hung I-hsuan's Various Histories Textual Notes says: "Wang Ch'iu written as Wang Lin is a scribal corruption."
translations.idiomatic: Hung I-hsuan's Various Histories Textual Notes says: "Wang Ch'iu written as Wang Lin is a copyist's error."

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午 「壬午」各本作「壬申」。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, jen-wu. "Jen-wu": all editions read "jen-shen."
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month of summer, jen-wu. "Jen-wu": all editions read jen-shen.

sentences.zh: 局本作「壬午」。
